With the flexibility, high precision and safety automation of the muzzle tightening process of small-caliber projectiles as the main research objectives, the mechanical device, electrical automatic control system and safety protection are designed. The experimental results show that the muzzle tightening device is advanced in design, has an accuracy of 0.06mm, realizes man-machine isolation, and is safe and reliable on the whole. The device designed in this paper improves the research efficiency of various physical properties of various types of small caliber shells.

articleTitle: Simulation and Research of Numerical Pipeline Constitutive Model Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: After modern greenhouses adopt water and fertilizer integrated intelligent irrigation technology, it not only saves water and fertilizer but also greatly reduces the intensity of human labor. This paper mainly simulates and verifies the basic performance of the main pipes and branch pipes that supply water and fertilizer in the water and fertilizer integrated machine, which is convenient for matching more suitable main pipes and branch pipes in material selection and establishes the main pipe for fertilization and branch pipes based on Johnson-Cook under large deformation conditions. The numerical calculation model of the constitutive equation is used to numerically simulate and analyze the mechanical response of the pipeline during uniaxial tension through the finite element analysis method. Combined with the stress-strain experimental data in the tensile process, the least square method is used to identify and fit the parameters of the Johnson-Cook constitutive equation, and the numerical model is coupled to perform finite element analysis to realize the strain of the main pipe and branch pipe during the tensile process. Numerical simulation of softening, diameter reduction, orientation hardening and other phenomena. The results show that the simulation results are in good agreement with the experimental results, and the research method is of reference for the establishment of nonlinear, large-deformation main pipe, and branch pipe behavior numerical models.

articleTitle: Application of PSO-BP Neural Network in GPS Height Fitting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of GPS height fitting, aiming at the shortcomings of BP neural network in application, such as slow learning convergence speed and easy to fall into local optimal solution, particle swarm optimization (PSO) has the advantages of global search performance and fast convergence speed. Globally optimizing the initial connection weight and threshold of BP neural network, PSO Optimized BP neural network is served as a foundation of a GPS elevation fitting model. It is the results that demonstrate that the BP neural network optimized by PSO proves feasible for GPS height fitting as well as the fitting accuracy can be effectively improved, with the supply of definite reference value for the establishment of a high-precision GPS elevation fitting model.

articleTitle: Application of Geographic Information System in the Small Watershed Comprehensive Management Information Digitization Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The comprehensive management of small watersheds can combine the local natural and socio-economic conditions, and consider the needs of developing the local national economy. It is one of the indispensable main contents of national soil and water conservation. The Beijing municipal government attaches particular importance to urban and rural environmental construction, and puts forward a new idea of comprehensive management of Small Watersheds Based on three lines of Defense: ecological restoration, ecological governance, and ecological protection. By analyzing the big data of Small Watershed Governance in Beijing, this paper lists the main ideas and achievements of Small Watershed Governance in Beijing, and discusses some problems existing in the governance process.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Reading Space Based on Computational Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to improve the dynamic allocation effect of intelligent reading space, a design method of intelligent reading space dynamic allocation system-based on visual cognition is proposed. Construct a visual cognitive model of dynamic allocation of intelligent reading space. The auxiliary visual image sampling model of intelligent reading space dynamic allocation graph is constructed, and the characteristic parameters and picture element parameters of intelligent reading space dynamic allocation graph are extracted. Combined with the three-dimensional distribution characteristic quantity of intelligent reading space dynamic allocation graph, the intelligent reading space dynamic allocation visual allocation model is established. The method of RGB color feature decomposition is adopted to realize the dynamic adjustment of intelligent reading space. The software development and design of intelligent reading space dynamic allocation system are carried out by the methods of visual information parameter fusion and three-dimensional visual reconstruction. The dynamic allocation system of intelligent reading space is designed in Mapinfo software development platform, and the visual simulation development of the dynamic allocation system of intelligent reading space is designed in Matlab simulation program. The simulation results show that the designed intelligent reading space has good dynamic allocation performance and strong computer vision expression ability.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Design of Computer 3D Simulation Special Effects Technology in the Shaping of Sci-Fi Animation Characters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As a new type of technology, film and television 3D animation has emerged with the development of computer hardware and software. Based on this background, the paper introduces the Sobel edge operator to establish a gray scale function to solve the gradient amplitude, and selects the threshold value to compare with it to complete the recognition and refinement of the edge data of the animated Figure image. Design the motion capture module, establish a behavior control model, generate and manage motion capture files, and complete the overall design of the system. Finally, it discusses the expressive power of special effects technology in computer animation design.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Big Data Technology in Robot Soccer Simulation Platform Based on OpenGL
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Computer big data technology is widely used in sports. The article uses football as an example to analyse the application of computer big data technology. The article establishes a small group robot soccer simulation platform based on OpenGL. The modelling of the simulation platform is simple and intuitive. It uses the ray tracing algorithm to realize the collision detection of the world model. It also accurately simulates the robot’s motion and ball control performance, and realizes a variety of human-computer interaction functions. Practice shows that the competition system has the advantages of low cost, good control performance, and strong interest, which can effectively stimulate students’ enthusiasm for learning.

articleTitle: Research on Service Framework and Specification of Digital Intelligent Component in Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article studies the online simulation technology architecture of intelligent distribution network based on distributed component services and proposes a service-oriented basic computing framework, coordination mechanisms for various modules, and distributed deployment modes. We propose a smart grid management service system integration framework based on the Internet of Things service system, give its architecture and functional modules, and elaborate on the key technologies, methods and processes of each module. Finally, the simulated user applies for the user identification service for theft of electricity, which realizes the unified processing and security authentication of data packets in the entire platform, which can effectively solve the problems of massive data management and data integrity protection and reliability authentication, which is the ubiquitous big data technology. The application of microgrid provides technical support.

articleTitle: The Dimensional Analysis of Tree Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As a common seeing but complicated structure, tree network has received a lot of attention. However, only a few studies were done on the three-dimensional tree structure. Here we study the tree network using fractal analysis and compare to other networks that are already studied. We illustrate our finding using fractal geometry and argue that there exist certain similarity between different tree networks.

articleTitle: SRAM Single Event Effect Detection Method and Smart System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This research creates a set of method and system to detect single event effect (SEE) in static random access memory (SRAM). This system is hoped to differentiate between the functional units inside the SRAM in their sensitivity to SEE in a relatively accurate way. To do this, the cyclotron HIRFL is used to generate heavy ions at different LET values at the Institute of Modern Physics, the Chinese Academy of Sciences, so as to simulate the space radiation environment where one home-grown SRAM device is tested for its ability to resist Single Event Upset (SEU) and Single Event Latchup (SEL). This research is also designed to provide a reference for creating the single event effect detection system suitable for other access memories in the future.

articleTitle: A study of the correlation and calculation between shooting accuracy and heart rate variability data analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, in order to find a scientific method to enhance the benefits of shooting training, heart rate variability was used as a quantitative index to express the physical and mental adaptation status of athletes, and analyze the relationship between HRV changes and shooting performance. RESULTS: (1) Young athletes have stronger ANS function than untrained youths of the same age, where parasympathetic activity is somewhat stronger. Parasympathetic tone is also greater in athletes with better shooting skills compared to average athletes. (2) The four indicators at rest, namely SDNN, LF/HF, HF norm, and CPX can be used as significant index factors to distinguish good and average shooters, and two non-linear indicators, SampEn and CPX, are also found to reflect the overall HRV activity.

articleTitle: Smart grid big data processing technology and cloud computing application status quo and challenges
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of China’s economy, people’s demand for electricity is increasing, so that the power grid will generate a large amount of data information in the actual operation, and the smart grid big data processing technology is to store and use the data information generated by the operation of the power grid.The ultimate purpose of applying big data processing technology is to make efficient use of the data information generated by the power grid, improve the rate of data access and processing, so as to provide necessary support and help for the normal operation of the power grid, and ensure that the national power grid can provide more stable power for people and enterprises.This paper focuses on the smart grid big data processing technology and opportunities and challenges.

articleTitle: Study on the classification model of lock mechanism in operating system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Lock design is an important mechanism for scheduling management and security protection in operating systems. However, there is no effective way to identify the differences and connections among lock models, and users need to spend considerable time to understand different lock architectures. In this paper, we propose a classification scheme that abstracts lock design into three types of models: basic spinlock, semaphore amount extension, lock chain structure, and verify the effectiveness of these three types of lock models in the context of current mainstream applications. We also investigate the specific details of applying this classification method, which can be used as a reference for developers to design lock models, thus shorten the software development cycle.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Big Data Technology Based on Two-Dimensional Code in Coal Mine Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the current situation of coal mine safety in China is still severe and the efficiency of supervision needs to be improved, a three-level networking platform for coal mine safety supervision based on big data has been designed and implemented. The platform adopts a hierarchical architecture design method, formulates and complies with data exchange standards and specifications, builds a three-level network of coal mines, districts, counties and regions, and realizes the effective integration of multiple coal mine heterogeneous system data sources. At the same time, we use the non-spatial attribute spatial clustering method and big data analysis method to mine coal mine safety information. The use of simulated data and actual data to verify that the spatial clustering method of non-spatial attributes can find the spatial clusters of arbitrary shape and density change of the QR code, and can well identify the noise points of the coal mine safety information system based on the QR code.

Author Keywords: spatial clustering method of non-spatial attributes

articleTitle: Insulator image data enhancement based on BIG-GAN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The data set of power grid equipment is difficult to obtain on a large scale due to the complex working environment of the power grid and many high-altitude operation scenarios, resulting in scarce data in many scenarios. Aiming at the problem of lack of image data of insulators on transmission lines, a data augmentation network based on BIG-GAN network is proposed for the first time. This network combines convolutional neural networks with batch standardization and sampling truncation techniques added to the convolutional neural network, which effectively improve the stability of the GAN network training process and the reconstruction effect of the generative model.

articleTitle: Data Mining Technology and Its Application in Multi-sensor Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Big data contains huge data value, can effectively promote the development of university information; However, there are many difficulties in the application of big data in multi-sensor data processing. In view of the practical problems faced by the current multi-sensor data processing and big data applications, the overall architecture design and the construction of core modules of multi-sensor data processing are carried out, including data acquisition, data governance, data storage, real-time computing and big data algorithm, data management, application service center and data security center. The application of multi-sensor data processing in data mining shows that it can meet the requirements of multi-sensor data processing and provide useful reference for multi-sensor data processing.

articleTitle: Research on investment balance rate calculation and computer prediction model of power grid infrastructure projects
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Investment balance control is an effective way for power grid enterprises to realize accurate investment. Based on the principle of accurate investment control of power grid engineering and aiming at meeting the needs of practical application, the investment balance rate prediction model constructed in this paper based on historical infrastructure projects data can improve the accuracy of project planning investment, feasibility study estimation and budgetary estimate investment. Through the intelligent analysis model of investment balance, we can scientifically predict the balance level of the projects, effectively analyze the investment cost level, and provide support for the release of investment plan.

articleTitle: Joint data analysis based on a study of consumer OTA upgrade feature preferences
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: OTA upgrade technology for new energy vehicles has become an important part of vehicle intelligence, and is now widely used in the field of new energy vehicles, and is gradually recognized and concerned by users. In order to explore users’ needs and preferences for OTA upgrades, this paper uses conjoint analysis to estimate the relative importance and attributes of OTA upgrades. The study found that the combination of OTA upgrade features of driving mode (powertrain domain), audio-visual entertainment (cabin entertainment domain), navigation system (body electronics domain) and vehicle recognition capability enhancement (autonomous driving domain) had a greater impact on users. In the future, car manufacturers can carry out OTA upgrades based on key functional directions to precisely match user needs while reducing OTA upgrade configuration costs.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Database Technology in Distributed Query Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Distributed data query is the core of distributed database management system, and query optimization algorithm is the key technology in query processing. From the perspective of energy efficiency, the article optimizes and analyzes the data query algorithm of WSNs. On the one hand, the node with the highest remaining energy is selected from the network nodes as the query node, that is, the dynamic rotation mechanism of the query node makes the energy consumption in the network balanced, thereby prolonging the life cycle of the network; on the other hand, a fuzzy matching query makes the process of data processing by the node is simplified, and the energy consumption of the node is reduced from the aspect of data processing. The simulation results show that the improved algorithm can find the optimal query execution plan in a short time, speed up the query, and improve the query efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis and Self-driving Algorithm Decision Mode Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The countries around the world are closely monitoring the legislative progress of road traffic safety and autonomous vehicles. This paper aims to focus on the innovation of autonomous vehicle algorithm and technical progress, analyzing the ethical dilemmas and finding out the most proper data counting mode. The ethical choice of autonomous driving systems will be hugely controversial around the world for a long period. The behavior of intelligent robots in moral dilemmas can be simulated using a fairly simple value-based calculating mode, which is attributed by participants to the makers of intelligent operating systems. Using the fully deterministic model, all possible paths are searched and the best path is determined using the digital computation function in this paper. The algorithm design mode of this paper is that the matrix algorithm should be adopted as the core algorithm mode, regression algorithm, reinforcement algorithm as the auxiliary algorithm modes.

articleTitle: Data Analysis and Calculation of Factors Affecting the Performance of Vehicle Rear-Axle Modules
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The simulation model of pneumatic rear axle module assembly is established by using AMESim software. Apply the AMESim structural simulation model of pneumatic rear axle module assembly, The simulation analysis shows that the specific effects on the static, dynamic, response and regulation functions of the pneumatic rear axle module assembly, by changing the model structure of the control piston diameter, intake valve piston diameter, exhaust valve piston diameter, return spring stiffness and exhaust valve spring stiffness. Provide data support for the preliminary design and later structural optimization of the pneumatic rear axle module assembly.

articleTitle: Data Model Optimized for Automatic Analysis Method of Corrosion Formation State of Typical Disconnectors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The normal working state of disconnector is a very important part of the whole power system. It not only affects the operation safety of power grid, but also has a direct impact on the service life and reliability of equipment. At present, there are serious opening and closing problems of circuit breakers in most areas. Therefore, aiming at the corrosion formation state of typical disconnectors, this paper optimizes its automatic analysis method and establishes a data model. Firstly, this paper introduces the operating conditions and functions of disconnectors. Then, this paper expounds the causes of corrosion formation, and designs a data model to analyze the formation state of corrosion. Finally, the experimental observation on the corrosion formation of typical disconnector materials is carried out. After the experimental test, the corrosion degree of the four materials is different. The metal surface finish is grade 13 and the metal composition is industrial pure aluminum brand. The disconnector No. 5056 has high corrosion resistance.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Intelligent Assessment Method of IT Operation and Maintenance Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Carrying out research on IT equipment management operation and maintenance services is an inevitable requirement to meet the needs of equipment management under the new situation and improve the IT equipment management information capability. Therefore, combined with the status quo of IT equipment management information construction, in view of its current contradictions and problems of insufficient operation and maintenance capabilities, an IT equipment management operation and maintenance platform program based on the ITIL framework is proposed. We designed the architecture and process of this platform to explore new solutions to improve IT equipment management information capabilities.

articleTitle: Dynamic Adaptive Marking Strategy Based on DCTCP in Data Center Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The Incast problem is common in data center networks (DCNs), which is easy to make throughput collapse. Today’s TCP/ECN protocol, such as Data Center TCP (DCTCP), uses Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) to send feedback to the sender to achieve high throughput and low latency. But as the number of senders increases further, DCTCP can not suppress incast effectively. The ECN-based mechanism is static marking, which does not guarantee high throughput and fairness at the same time. In addition, the mark-tail strategy in DCTCP causes congestion signals to experience longer queuing delays, resulting in queue oscillations. In order to overcome these shortcomings, this paper proposes a dynamic adaptive(DA) marking strategy, named DCTCP-DA, which automatically adjusts the marking strategy according to the queue gradient. This scheme can guarantee the fairness of different flows. When encountering burst traffic, it can send the congestion signal to the sender faster and prevent the occurrence of timeout. Simulation on NS-3 shows that DCTCP-DA can delay the throughput collapse caused by Incast, control the queue more effectively, and improve the fairness of different flows.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data Technology in Satellite Remote Sensing Map Cartography and Geographic Information
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article theoretically studies the process of shadow generation in remote sensing images, and obtains the quantitative relationship between the gray value of the same pixel point when there is no shadow and when there is shadow. The article uses the shadow detection and removal method of RGB color space to detect and remove the shadow of the moving target. We use mathematical morphology to complete the trimming and reconstruction of the target area. The experimental results show the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Transductive Zero-shot Learning with New Semantic Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) is an important machine learning paradigm that trains models to handle samples from classes that are unseen during training. Most ZSL methods transfer knowledge about the seen to unseen classes using some semantic representations, such as annotated attribute vectors or word embeddings. However, such information is either difficult to acquire or lack of linkage to visual information. We thus propose a novel transductive ZSL paradigm that makes use of feature maps to distill less expensive but more informative semantic embeddings of seen and unseen classes. Experimental results on different datasets show that this method can significantly improve the performance compared to the latest ZSL models.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Teaching System Based on Microservice Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Under the promotion of new technology, it has become an important trend of educational reform to strengthen the integration and innovation of smart technology and teaching, and promotes the reform of talent training mode and teaching methods. Aiming at the problems existing in the construction of smart teaching system, this paper analyzes the connotation of smart teaching environment and the requirements of smart teaching system, and puts forward the design objectives, physical structure, application architecture and technical scheme of smart teaching system. The micro service architecture improves the performance and scalability of the system, ensures the accurate and timely transmission of teaching information, and effectively supports smart teaching.

articleTitle: Bank intelligent auxiliary management system based on machine vision and facial recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This project designs an intelligent banking management system.The essence of intelligent management system is an intelligent information management system based on computer technology, communication technology, sensing technology, automatic control technology and video technology.It integrates the information and communication of the entrance to the bank building, the bank staff and the security department into one network, and introduces the database of dangerous goods and dangerous people.This system is the precise processing center of K210 and other rough processing modules, which will be connected with the police command center. The network will become an important security guarantee means to prevent the bank from being invaded illegally, and effectively protect the personal and property safety of customers. At the same time, in addition to the function of risk control, the system can also import the customer database, realize the customer can enjoy the exclusive service at the door, effectively improve the customer experience.

articleTitle: Research on Spatial Durbin Model for Highway Trip Generation by Intelligent Traffic Volume Forecast System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: China has entered the new normal of economy and the progress of urban agglomerations, interurban highway trip generation is likely be affected by socio-economic factors spatially. This study analysed the interaction of socio-economic and trip demand in spatial level from 2008 to 2017, and principal component analysis and spatial panel data analysis methods were applied to our issue. The results indicated that the socio-economic factors such as economic development and industrial transformation not only were directly related to trip generation of passenger vehicle and freight vehicle, but also had indirect effects in spatial level. The estimation effects of the proposed spatial Durbin model for trip generation were similar to those for fixed effect panel model, which were better than the pooled model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Independent Energy Storage Business Model Based on Lithium-ion Batteries System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Under the background of energy reform in the new era, energy enterprises have become a global trend to transform from production to service. Especially under the “carbon peak and neutrality” target, Chinese comprehensive energy services market demand is huge, the development prospect is broad, the development trend is good. Energy storage technology, as an important part of the comprehensive energy system, has multiple values for improving the safety and reliability, economy and greenness of the energy system, and is a major focus direction of Chinese energy reform. As the hottest electric energy storage technology at present, lithium-ion batteries have a good application prospect, and as an independent energy storage power station, its business model is worth promoting.

articleTitle: A Region-Tree Based Fault-tolerant Routing Algorithm for Network-on-Chip
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Fault-tolerant routing algorithms play an important role in Network-on Chips (NoCs) nowadays. Region based method and tree based method are two effective approaches. However, region based methods generate faulty blocks, sacrificing a lot of healthy nodes inside faulty blocks. Tree based methods try to reach full fault-coverage, but lead to worse latency. To achieve a better tradeoff, we propose a region-tree based routing algorithm. The proposed algorithm routes packets as XY based routing algorithm in healthy areas and tree based routing algorithm in faulty areas, combining the high efficiency of region based algorithms and high fault coverage of tree based algorithms. The proposed algorithm is proved as deadlock-free. Experimental results show that proposed algorithm improves utilization rate by 43% compared to current method without increasing latency.

articleTitle: A new anti-moss coating for external insulation of substation equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, an anti-moss and antibacterial coating for the external insulation of substation equipment is prepared, and its surface morphology, adhesion, hydrophobicity, anti-ultraviolet performance, self-cleaning performance, damp and heat resistance, dielectric performance, and electrical performance are analyzed. The results show that the anti-moss coating has a smooth and flat surface, good adhesion, hydrophobic properties, anti-ultraviolet properties, self-cleaning properties, and moisture and heat resistance. When the DCOIT content is 0.5%, the coating has better dielectric and electrical properties.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Technology in Civil Engineering Building Computer Assisted Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This research proposes a logical model of computer-supported collaborative work in architectural design, and discusses the collaborative control, collaborative objects, and data management based on the characteristics of the collaborative work goal, implementation process, and control mechanism of architectural design. And local patterns such as design changes. At the same time, the article puts forward a new architectural CAD system 3DMECAD with a three-Model Of Collaborative Work dimensional modeling engine as the core, and demonstrates the system structure, modeling engine concepts and algorithms of the system. This article discusses the basic design ideas, structural system and specific implementation technology of 3DMECAD. The system has the advantages of high integration, strong applicability, and high reliability. It can complete various tasks in the whole process of architectural design and has a wide range of application prospects.

articleTitle: NAT experimental design and result analysis based on simulation technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: NAT technology can solve the problem of IP address resource shortage, and it is widely used in the actual network construction. This paper first completes the DESIGN of NAT experimental project of an enterprise network, then realizes the simulation design by using Cisco simulator, and finally analyzes the results such as connectivity test, NAT address translation table analysis and IP data report analysis, and expounds the working principle of NAT intuitively. This research can provide students with the opportunity of self-exploration, help students to understand the theoretical knowledge in depth, is a useful exploration of undergraduate education reform.

articleTitle: Reducing the noise in power quality disturbance with VMD
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, an improved variational modal decomposition (VMD) denoising algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the noisy signal is decomposed into several intrinsic modes (IMF); Then the correlation coefficient algorithm is used to determine the optimal number of decomposition layers; The relevant modes and useful components are extracted and reconstructed to obtain the denoised signal. Practice shows that this method has better denoising effect than traditional empirical mode decomposition and wavelet decomposition.

articleTitle: Design of Satellite Ultra High speed Payload Data Transmission System Based on Convolutional Coding Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In today’s society, due to the development of science and technology, human demand for satellite communication is higher and higher. At present, most places and departments in China have established their own unique transmission mode. Wireless data transmission system is a new efficient, safe and reliable information transmission mode. However, there are a series of problems in traditional wired signal transmission, such as serious waste of resources and complex network, which can not meet the communication requirements under high-speed payload. Therefore, the research and design of new schemes to improve satellite transmission capacity is of great significance and value to the development trend of today’s society. Therefore, this paper designs a satellite ultra-high speed payload data transmission system based on convolutional coding technology. Firstly, this paper introduces the concept of satellite ultra-high effective data transmission, then expounds the development process of data transmission, and studies the application of convolutional coding technology. Then the system structure of satellite ultra-high speed payload data transmission is designed, and the performance of convolutional coding technology of the system is tested. Finally, the test results show that convolutional coding technology is very efficient in identifying wrong coding, and can effectively improve the efficiency of information reception.

articleTitle: AICF: Attentional Item-interaction Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As of today, deep learning technology has been widely utilized in the field of recommendation algorithms. Many work utilizes the multilayer perceptrons to simulate inner product operations in matrix factorization (MF) models. Hence, those works inherit a weakness of MF, namely the ineffectiveness of identifying between a small group of closely related items. The association of items, such as high-order relations between items, endows the recommendation system with valuable information on the user’s final choices. In accordance with the above facts, this paper proposes an Attentional Item-Interaction Collaborative Filtering model (AICF). It can distinguish which items in the user’s historical interaction items play a more important role in the user’s choice of items. To examine the performance of AICF, we designed multiple experiments on two real world data sets.

articleTitle: TCP-CFCC: Proximal Policy Optimization for Congestion Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In TCP/IP networks, the key to ensuring efficient and fair sharing of network resources between users is the TCP congestion control algorithm. Traditional congestion control algorithms based on pre-defined rules cannot cope with the challenges of increasing network traffic and diversified services due to the limitations of basic assumptions. This paper proposes a TCP congestion control algorithm CFCC based on the deep reinforcement learning algorithm PPO. The algorithm model is based on CNN and F-CNN. The model is updated according to the network features (throughput, round-trip time, etc.) and the feedback information (reward) of the current network environment, and the sending rate is adjusted online. Using CFCC can make the sender more accurately understand the changes in the network environment and adjust the sending window in time. Simulation experiments on the Pantheon platforms show that the overall performance of CFCC in a variety of experimental scenarios is better than traditional heuristic congestion control algorithms such as CUBIC and Vegas.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Big Data and Cloud Computing in Accounting Collection Computer Statistics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article focuses on the imperfect auxiliary accounting functions, lack of multi-unit business collaborative processing capabilities, and the need to strengthen information integration and sharing found in the process of applying accounting sub-system V5.0 in the process of applying the accounting statement subsystem V5.0. Platform, microservices, front-end separation and other technologies, design and implement enterprise accounting and report processing subsystem V6.0, and carefully consider data migration issues during system upgrades. The enterprise pilot application shows that the system helps to promote smooth communication of accounting information, fine and complete accounting content, and standard accounting business standards, provide strong support for accounting information sharing and standard accounting basic work, significantly improve financial management and control capabilities, and improve accounting efficiency and efficiency. Quality, with strong promotion and application value.

articleTitle: Exploration and Analysis of the Path Optimization of Labour Recommendation Model Based on Big Data and Auto-Kg Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: At present, labour education has a significant status and role in higher education. It not only meets the basic needs of students' social life, but it is also a measure of the comprehensive quality of students. Based on the perspective of big data and system dynamics, the article designs an adaptive college labour education learning system. The system includes domain model, learner model, adaptive model and cognitive diagnosis model. The article uses Auto-kg algorithm to construct a knowledge map of the learning content of labour education in colleges and universities. Design adaptive learning content recommendation strategy based on learner's learning style and realize adaptive recommendation of learning content. The results show that the recommendation model can significantly improve the learning effect of learners.

articleTitle: Strong-sound-induced emotional potency and convergent avoidance responses
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, the experimental design was generated through the psychological experimental system E-prime, and a modified simulated villain task experimental paradigm was used to conduct tendency avoidance response experiments, record subjects’ tendency avoidance choices after stimulation with different sound pressure level noise samples, analyze their tendency avoidance choice reaction time, tendency avoidance motivation strength, and tendency avoidance distance experimental data, and investigate the changes of tendency avoidance triggered by negative emotions with different arousal degrees under the effect of strong sound. The experimental results showed that avoidance responses were produced after negative emotions were generated under strong sound stimuli. High-frequency strong sound stimuli elicited stronger avoidance behavioral responses in subjects than medium- and low-frequency strong sounds. The degree of subjects’ avoidance behavioral responses was positively correlated with sound pressure level intensity.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Higher Education Enrollment Rate in Cambodia Based on ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The modern education system in Cambodia over the past 30 years has failed to support the development of the country and the progress of society, mainly because of a gradual decline in the number of people enrolled in higher education. Forecasting contributes to research on the state of higher education because it continuously explores historical, current and ongoing data relationships in specific situations within the educational context. This paper applied the famous ARIMA(p,d,q) model to predict higher education general student enrollment rate for Cambodia's higher education using the crawled overall college enrollment data from 1998 to 2015. The optimal prediction model was determined to be ARIMA(2,1,2) by testing different models. A Chi-square test was performed on the optimal model ARIMA(2,1,2), and a p-value of 2.3343 greater than 0.05 showed that the model was statistically significant and could be applied. The relative error between the predicted value and the actual value was 1.018% through calculation, illustrating that the model accuracy was high. The simulation result indicated that ARIMA(2,1,2) model appeared to be the statistically appropriate model to forecast the higher education enrollment rate in Cambodia.

articleTitle: Research on Drill Floor Working Condition Recognition Method Based on Video Understanding
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The Drilling Working Condition recognition is a new and challenging research task. We proposed a 3D attentional network based on dual-core modeling (DCM-3D) for recognizing the Drilling Working Condition. Exploring the uniformity and regularity of the drilling working conditions from multiple dimensions, the proposed DCM-3D Net employed the SlowFast framework and designed a 3D attention neural network based on dual-core modeling for effectively spatio-temporal modeling the long rectangular objects. According to the characteristics of the drilling movement and the video continuity, we designed the attention network module and data augmentation module. The experimental results proved that the proposed method effectively improves the performance of the Drilling Working Condition recognition, and surpassed the other state-of-the-art video recognition methods in this task.

articleTitle: Research on power engineering solutions based on NB-IoT technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Safety production and quality assurance are important goals of infrastructure construction. How to use cutting-edge technologies to improve the safety indicators of infrastructure construction sites and achieve intelligent management is the research purpose of this article. With the widespread application of Internet technology, technologies such as the Internet of Things, 5G technology, and artificial intelligence are integrated to infrastructure construction sites to complement the advantages of traditional information platforms, achieve effective information integration, and improve the real-time nature and the degree of automation of the construction management system. This article, based on the construction process of power transmission and transformation projects, adopts the latest generation of 5G narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IOT) technology to carry out a comprehensive monitoring layout on the construction site, implements management from multiple perspectives such as personnel management, risk avoidance, and quality control, and establishes an intelligent construction site management system of electrical construction, so as to realize the automatic and real-time information collection and processing of the construction site, and effectively improve the safety factor, work efficiency and engineering quality of the site. The effectiveness of the system application also promotes the further integration of the development of the Internet of Things technology and infrastructure work.

articleTitle: Mathematical evaluation model of the relationship between earnings and under-pricing in the long-term through big data analysis and calculation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Investors’ performance was always mislead by Initial public offering (IPO) firms by using earnings management, so that the shares are overvalued in the market where they belong public. But over a long period, the genuine firm value prevails. As the earnings usually be exaggerated just before IPO, specially for non-government-owned companies, Share offer price changes as a result, the investor’s interest may be influenced. Thus, in this paper, we took a listed companies in China as the research objects, extracting their financial data of the last three years before IPO, leveraging the unique detailed bid data of institutional investors during the whole IPO process, compares the influence of earnings management on them before and after IPO in the long term. We set the bid price and earnings management as the key variables; quantify earnings management through important financial information, using the regression model and try to contribute the linear relationship; analyzing the accrual-based earnings management and the real earnings management to see earnings management’s influence and relationship with IPO offer price. The hypothesis is that earnings management in Chinese IPO companies is negatively associated with IPO underpricing.

articleTitle: The Following System of 3D Simulation Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, the three-dimensional motion camera of Kinect sensor is used to scan the space where the human body is to capture human movements in real time, and in the upper machine processing platform real-time display of the human body movement state, analyze the action instructions corresponding to different actions of the human body, and complete the 3D simulation manipulator following the actions of the human body. After debugging, the system designed in this paper can accurately recognize gestures without obvious delay, and the manipulator can follow the human arm well.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Screening Algorithm of Electric Power Image Recognition Data Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, artificial intelligence digital image processing technology is used to process power images to form an automatic power image screening system. This method can replace the traditional artificial power image recognition method. This paper studies the specific methods of power image processing and the feasibility of applying them to power image recognition systems. It studies various algorithms for image recognition data automatic screening, feature extraction and pattern recognition, and studies feature extraction for power images. As well as a variety of algorithms for model recognition, we have studied the monitoring and recognition algorithms for power images based on SIFT and RANSAC methods. The selected template image and the key points of the test image are roughly matched. RANSAC removes the wrong matching points. Affine transformation, positioning the set template image in the test image.

articleTitle: DeepAPArice: a deep learning model for poly(A) site intelligent prediction in rice using convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Polyadenylation [poly(A)] is an extremely important step in the post-transcriptional process of premRNA, which plays a key role in gene regulation, protein binding and translation efficiency. Accurate identification of poly(A) sites can help understand gene expression regulation and improve the accuracy of gene annotation. Although there have been many machine learning methods used for poly(A) site prediction, most of them only take into account a limited set of features. With the increase of the amount of genomic data and the development of computing technology, deep learning technology has been used for solving many machine learning tasks. Here, we propose DeepAPArice, a deep learning model that predicts poly(A) sites in Oryza Sativa based on sequence features and RNA secondary structures around poly(A) sites. We compared DeepAPArice with both traditional machine learning algorithms and advanced deep learning algorithms, and the results show that DeepAPArice is superior to them in terms of several indicators.

articleTitle: A Monopulse Radar Anti-jamming Method Based on Labeled GM-PHD
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Monopulse tracking radar can achieve high tracking and measurement precision and is widely used in space exploration, target measurement and weapon control areas. The anti-jamming of monopulse radar is an important issue. When jamming is treated as one or more false targets, radar anti-jamming can be regarded as a multiple targets tracking problem. This paper proposed a monopulse radar anti-jamming method based on labeled Gaussian Mixture Probability Hypothesis Density (GM-PHD) filtering. Firstly, random finite set (RFS) theory, GM-PHD filtering and labeled GM-PHD are introduced, then labeled GM-PHD filtering is used to distinguish jammer from the real target by four steps: prediction, update, cut and merge, and state estimation. Finally delay-retransmit jamming simulation was performed to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Architecture of control system of automobile inspection line based on CAN bus
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of automobile inspection technology in China, automobile inspection line has become quite common. Generally, the automobile inspection line is composed of several computers connected to each other, each computer controls a station, and finally, the main control computer gives the inspection results. CAN (Control Area Network) bus is a serial communication network with distributed control, and it is also a non-destructive bus arbitration technology that can receive multiple data messages. Nodes with high priority will send data messages first, while nodes with low priority will stop transmitting. This paper puts forward the scheme of architecture reform of control system of automobile inspection line based on CAN bus. Practice shows that the computer control system of automobile automatic inspection line can realize automobile inspection with high reliability and low cost.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Operation Technology of Distributed Data Center
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Due to the use of active and standby machines to process all real-time data at the same time, the existing data acquisition and monitoring (SCADA) system faces severe challenges in terms of data throughput, real-time performance, scalability, and reliability. In-depth research has been conducted on the storage of massive amounts of dynamic sensing data in large-scale smart grids, and the objective requirements of smart grids for data transmission, storage and query have been fully considered, and a distributed data storage method has been proposed to deal with it. The storage strategy for the massive data generated during the operation of the smart grid. Experiments have verified the low latency and high throughput advantages of the framework.

articleTitle: Research on Torque Distribution of Electric Four-wheel Drive Based on Optimal Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With a dual-motor electric four-wheel drive SUV as a prototype, the torque distribution coefficients of the front and rear motors with optimal energy-consumption in the drive mode were analyzed and calculated. Through simulation and comparison of torque distribution under optimal energy consumption and at fixed proportion, energy consumption of the pure rear wheel drive at low speed and that under reasonable torque distribution at high speed was reduced by 10%, 3% and 5% compared with that under torque distribution at fixed proportion in NEDC, WLTC and CATC, thus providing data references for optimizing the economic performance of the vehicle.

articleTitle: New Computer Big Data Technology in the Intelligent Operation and Maintenance Monitoring of IT Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of the construction and application of various information systems, the monitoring data generated by the information system has increased in series, and the effective storage and real-time analysis and processing of massive operation and maintenance data have become new challenges facing enterprises. Based on the background of this research, a solution for IT operation and maintenance data management system based on big data technology is proposed. The program logically divides the data management system into four layers: data integration, data storage, data calculation, and data access. Through system simulation, it is found that the system can accurately understand the operating status of the private cloud platform in a timely and accurate manner, greatly improving the efficiency of enterprise IT operation and maintenance management.

articleTitle: Research on University Library Information database under Digital Information Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the digital information environment, the information service value of university library has the characteristics of large amount of information, many objects and great differences. In the digital information environment with large amount of information, combined with the strategy of optimal allocation of resources, this paper constructs the optimization model of University Library’s information service value, establishes the optimization strategy of University Library’s information service value under the digital library environment, and analyzes the value of University Library’s information service. Under the “people-oriented” service concept, this paper probes into the characteristics of the information needs of teachers and readers, establishes the information service relationship of University Library through network virtual communication, improves the quality of information service, reconstructs the subject oriented comprehensive knowledge object, and integrates the content evaluation of user wisdom, which is an important basis for other users to measure the value of resources. It creates a good “resonance” value, uses the wisdom of users to reconstruct knowledge, and reduces the time for other users to search, filter and organize resources. Based on the service-oriented logic, this paper analyzes the situation of user intelligence integration in digital knowledge space, probes into the way of user intelligence integration in knowledge service, and improves the information service value of University Library under the digital information environment.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data Technology in the Fiscal Revenue Model Using Mathematical Statistics and Smart Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper uses the data of China’s three major industries’ value-added, employment and China’s fiscal revenue from 2000 to 2020 to conduct an empirical study on the factors affecting China’s fiscal revenue. This article compares and analyzes the different effects of primary industry added value, secondary industry added value, tertiary industry added value, employment number and other variables on fiscal revenue. It can be seen that the largest impact is the tertiary industry added value, followed by the secondary industry’s increase. value. The national fiscal revenue is most affected by the total output value of the service industry and the total population of the country. Finally, we also draw on the relevant principles and technologies of mathematical statistics and information systems to build a fiscal revenue monitoring and early warning system, and try to achieve dynamic monitoring and early warning of government revenue on the computer through quantitative research and system analysis.

articleTitle: Progressive Image Generation Model Based on Multi-level Features
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of high-quality appearance product generation, a progressive image generation model based on multi-level features is proposed in this paper. The algorithm divides the image generation task into multiple stages, and each stage aims to generate the features of a specific abstraction level. Start from the high-level features, and then introduce the lower level features step by step with the training. This incremental generation algorithm enables the model to first focus on high-level abstract semantic information and large-scale structural information, and then gradually shift its attention to more and more fine scales without learning all scales at the same time. The design of the algorithm is inspired by the process of drawing the picture by the painter. The painter first outlines an approximate outline in the image area, and then depicts the detailed texture according to the color of the reference image, so that the whole picture looks more harmonious and consistent. This incremental generation method not only makes the generation process more orderly, but also at each stage in the later order, because the features to be generated have completed the generation of the previous abstract level, the generation task at the current stage is equivalent to being simplified, that is, the incremental generation strategy can use the knowledge learned from the previous subtask to simplify the learning of subsequent subtasks, Therefore, it is easier to train and get better results than the traditional one-step generation algorithm.

articleTitle: A Digital Extraction Method of Gaussian Pulse Signal Timing Point
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a Gaussian interpolation timing point extraction algorithm based on FPGA is implemented. According to the problem that the timing point error is less than 6ns cannot be satisfied when the effective digit is less than 7 bits, an improved algorithm for accurately extracting Gaussian pulse timing point based on FPGA is designed. Analyzed the source of timing error, the comparison of maximum error between the direct extraction algorithm, Gaussian interpolation algorithm and the improved Gaussian interpolation algorithm is presented when the sampling number is 7 and the peak is full scale. It is concluded that the improved Gaussian interpolation timing algorithm can effectively improve the timing accuracy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Data Prediction Model of Catalyst and Temperature Combination Strategy Based on Stochastic Forest Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The technology of ethanol conversion to olefins, alkanes and aromatics is a strategic choice for China’s petrochemical industry and has great development potential. Firstly, the data prediction model was established with the parameters and temperature in the catalyst combination as the input and the C4 olefin yield as the output. Therefore, we use the experimental data to train the three models of random forest, BP neural network and gradient lifting regression (GBR), and compare the predicted data with the experimental real data. Through the error analysis of RMSE, MAE and R-squared indexes, it is found that the predicted value obtained by the random forest model is closest to the real value. Then, in order to obtain the specific parameter value when the C4 olefin yield is the maximum, we use the particle swarm optimization (PSO) to build the model, and take the relationship between output and input in the random forest model as the fitness function to obtain the optimal composition and temperature of the catalyst without temperature limit and when the temperature is lower than 350 °C.

articleTitle: PCB embedded magnetic technology and design implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of PCB industry into the system packaging (SOP) stage, and the development of power electronic magnetic devices to high-frequency and miniaturization, PCB embedded magnetic materials has become an important direction to solve the system integration of magnetic devices. This paper introduces the technology of embedded magnetic materials in PCB, and focuses on the design and simulation of embedded magnetic device in PCB. Magnetic materials are embedded into PCB through grooving, embedding, filling and pressing, and then circuit interconnection is realized through drilling, electroplating and etching to form embedded magnetic devices. Different from traditional winding implementation, PCB embedded magnetic design requires magnetic inductance, winding number and current carrying capacity calculation, and three-dimensional electromagnetic field overall electrical performance simulation. In the design process, it is considered to increase capacitance to match the impedance of the overall signal transmission link, reduce distributed capacitance to improve common-mode rejection ratio to reduce EMC risk, the output end is far away from the input end to facilitate port isolation and signal transmission, and add exhaust holes to avoid the thermal expansion and layer of PCB as a whole. In addition, this paper introduces the challenges and solutions of PCB embedded magnetic technology. In this paper, the discussion of PCB embedded magnetic technology and design implementation is conducive to increase the understanding of industry engineers on PCB embedded magnetic technology and design.

articleTitle: Research on the Mathematical Statistical Relationship between Children’s Income and the Support Accepted by the Elderly through Regression Model and Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper uses the 2018 survey data from the China Health and Senior Care Tracking Survey (CHARLS) project database to construct a statistical model through regression methods. The study found that there is a statistically significant positive correlation between rural middle-aged and elderly people and their children’s economic exchanges and children’s income levels. At the same time, this study explains the reasons for the results of this statistical model, and based on the mathematical statistical conclusions of this paper, provides policy recommendations for enhancing the welfare of the rural middle-aged and elderly people: under the background that the Chinese government’s old-age security is still playing a bottom line, it should promote employment, Taxation policies and other methods to increase the disposable income level of rural middle-aged and elderly children, in order to promote their economic support for rural middle-aged and elderly people, improve the living standards and well-being of rural middle-aged and elderly people, and properly cope with the current serious aging in rural areas problem.

articleTitle: An Adaptability Evaluation System of Flexibility Enhancement Technologies for Thermal Power Units
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The booming of renewable energy generation triggers high levels of uncertainty for power systems. The implementation of flexibility enhancement projects for thermal power units has become the main measure to accommodate the renewable energy resource. However, there are various flexibility enhancement technologies and lack of systematic review concerning technical adaptability. This paper proposes an adaptability evaluation system of flexibility enhancement technologies to provide guidance for thermal power plants. Firstly, the systematic review of flexibility enhancement technologies for thermal power units is formulated based on transformation purpose, such as enhancing the negative peak regulation capacity, and improving the AGC (Automatic generation control) regulation rates. Then, the adaptability evaluation system for flexibility enhancement technologies are proposed. This paper can help thermal power units choose the most adaptive flexibility enhancement technology and improve their own competitiveness in ancillary service market.

articleTitle: Landing Signal Officer Simulation Training System Based on Intelligent Flight
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Simulation training can reduce the cost and risk of training. According to the characteristics of aircraft landing, this paper designs a simulation training system specially applied to the Landing Signal Officer, and expounds the design of each subsystem in detail. Among them, the flight simulation processes the command instruction according to the pilot knowledge base, the model dynamics parameter database, the route characteristic database and the special situation flight database, simulate the flight movement law realistically, realize the intelligent pilot mode, and can realize the single command training of the landing signal officer. The application shows that the system can greatly shorten the time to realize the optimal combination of “man-machine” and effectively improve the training efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data and Web-based Intelligent Information System in Classroom Network Video Course
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: At present, the classroom teaching part of the Web-based learning management system has the problems of insufficient expression of teaching resources, difficulty in synchronization of courseware, lack of teaching scenarios and interactivity. The article designs and develops a Web-based classroom teaching video analysis and diagnosis system. The system can embed cue points in classroom teaching videos, mark the videos in segments and corresponding editing processing, and automatically generate analysis reports and diagnostic results according to relevant classroom analysis models and diagnostic criteria, and establish keywords and segmented videos at the same time Index, and can quickly find the required videos, which is conducive to improving teachers’ comprehensive skills and classroom teaching efficiency.

articleTitle: Construction of Hash Function Algorithm Based on Chen Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, Chen chaotic system with relatively high complexity is used to construct hash function. Aiming at the low efficiency of hash function constructed by high-dimensional continuous chaotic mapping algorithm, an algorithm for grouping and mapping plaintext blocks is proposed. The experimental results show that compared with the existing mainstream chaotic hash algorithm, the avalanche characteristics and disordered distribution of this algorithm still remain, and the confusion and diffusion are more stable. At the same time, this algorithm is very suitable for running on parallel systems.

articleTitle: A New Information Hiding Scheme Using Discrete Wavelet Transform at Physical Layer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The discrete wavelet transform (DWT) separates a signal into different frequency components with less arithmetic operations, and it is widely applied in information encryption. In this paper, we use DWT to embed and retrieve secret information at the physical layer, with small affection in the performance of the wireless communication system. The new scheme allows the secret signal to be transmitted to the intended receiver. The hidden secret can be considered as Gaussian noise superimposed on the original message signal. Simulation results illustrate stealth and robustness of our scheme in AWGN and Rayleigh fading channels. With the results, it is found that the proposed scheme is suitable for message watermarking and authentication.

articleTitle: A Synchronous Distributed Generator Excitation Control Measures Aimed at Automatic Reclosing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The access of the synchronous Distributed Generator will provide fault current for the short-circuit point of distribution network, which will lead to the malfunction of automatic reclosing. In response to the above problems, this paper proposes a measure to limit the fault current which is injected by Distributed Generator (DG). Firstly, the action mode of automatic reclosing and the influence of synchronous DG on the arc extinguishing during the fault are analyzed, and the reason for the failure of reclosure is obtained. Secondly, the theoretical model of arc is analyzed, the relationship between arc voltage and current under the condition of arc extinction is deduced, and the current expression under synchronous DG suppression measures proposed in this paper is brought into the corresponding setting conditions of controllable parameters. Finally, matlab is used to simulate to get the arc voltage and current. By comparing waveform of way under taking suppression method with waveform of way not taking method, we can verify the validity and feasibility of this method. It is proved that after adopting the suppression method in this paper, the automatic reclosing can effectively avoid the influence of synchronous DG.

articleTitle: A Continuous-Time Sigma-Delta Modulator with Compensating Transconductance Stages and RZ FIR-DAC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper introduces an energy-efficient continuous-time sigma-delta modulator (CTSDM) that adopts transconductance stages compensating for the low frequency gain of the integrator, which injects an opposite signal into the input of the integrator to compensate for the degradation of performance and phase response caused by limited DC gain, and further reduces the requirement of each integrator to realize a low-power design. In addition, the association between return-to-zero (RZ) pulse and finite-impulse-response (FIR) digital-to-analog converter (DAC) in the feedback path of the modulator can reduce the influence of clock jitter and inter-symbol interference (ISI) on the signal-to-noise-and-distortion ratio (SNDR) and the linearity of the system. The implementation and experimental results show that the CTSDM achieves 98.7 dB SNDR in a 24 kHz bandwidth (BW), and dissipates 144.4$\mu$W under 1.2V power supply, this corresponds to a figure-of-merit (FoM) of 180.9 dB, this work is applied to codec applications in edge computing.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Deep Learning in Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Deep learning is a technical tool with broad application prospects and has an important role in the field of image recognition. In view of the theoretical value and practical significance of image recognition technology in promoting the development of computer vision and artificial intelligence, this paper will review and study the application of deep learning in image recognition. This paper first outlines the development of icon recognition technology, and then introduces three main learning models in deep learning: convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, and generative adversarial networks, and provides a comparative analysis of these three learning models. Finally, the research results of deep learning image recognition application fields, such as face recognition, medical image recognition, and remote sensing image classification, are analyzed and discussed. This paper also analyze the development trend of deep learning in the field of image recognition, and conclude that the future development direction is the effective recognition of video images and the theoretical strengthening of models.

articleTitle: Research on Cross-chain Technology of Blockchain: Challenges and Prospects
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As one of the core technologies of blockchain, cross-chain technology has been widely valued by academia and industry, and has made a series of research achievements in recent years. At present, the overview research on cross-chain technology generally compares and analyzes cross-chain technology as a whole, and lacks the decoupling comparison of the main steps in cross-chain technology. Firstly, the basic principle of cross-chain technology is summarized and analyzed. Then, the cross-chain technology is divided into two types: isomerism and isomorphism, and the existing problems and corresponding solutions are analyzed and compared. Finally, the development status and trend of cross-chain technology are summarized, as well as important research directions in the future.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain Digital Identity Technology in Healthcare Consumer Finance System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of information leakage, data silos and uncontrolled identity caused by centralized storage in the existing healthcare consumer finance system, this paper proposes a design of healthcare consumer finance system based on distributed digital identity architecture. The article introduces the overall architecture and application process of the system, and builds a corresponding demonstration system based on Hyperledger Indy blockchain technology platform, implements the key functions of the system and conducts feasibility verification.
