It is proved that the system model has good security and time efficiency, and can realize secure and efficient information sharing between financial institutions and financial consumers.

articleTitle: Research on Brain Glioma Segmentation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Due to the complexity of the imaging technology of medical imaging and the high heterogeneity of the surface of gliomas, image segmentation of human brain gliomas is one of the most challenging tasks in medical image analysis. This paper improves the UNet++ medical image segmentation network, in the down-sampling stage of the decoder, crosschannel fusion is carried out and deep supervision is introduced, at this time, the improved network can fuse coarsegrained semantics and fine-grained semantics at full scale. Experiments were performed on 335 images in the public BraTS brain tumor segmentation data set, using 2D and 3D comparative segmentation experiments to comprehensively evaluate the segmentation performance of the improved network, and compare the segmentation results with the results of UNet, UNet++, and UNet3 medical image segmentation networks. Among the four indicators of Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC), 95% Hausdorff surface distance(HSD95), Sensitivity, and Positive Predictive Value (PPV), 2D contrast segmentation is achieved the mean values of the indicators are: 83.70%, 1.7, 88.40%, 84.96%; the mean values of the 3D contrast segmentation experiment are: 90.79%, 0.242, 91.23%, 91.06%. Compared with the segmentation result indicators of the other three networks, in the 2D comparison experiment, DSC increased by 1.82% on average, HSD95 decreased by 0.35 on average, Sensitivity increased by 2.13% on average, and PPV increased by 0.80% on average; in the 3D comparison experiment, DSC increased by 2.78% on average, HSD95 decreased by 0.076 on average, Sensitivity increased by 3.81% on average, and PPV increased by 0.68% on average. The experiments show that the improved algorithm makes the segmentation result of glioma and the gold standard overlap more in the region, and can better complete the segmentation of glioma. In clinical applications, it can help neurosurgeons to effectively separate brain tumors and tissues around the human brain, and achieve rapid computer diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: An Approach to Converting Relational Database to Graph Database: from MySQL to Neo4j
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: At present, there are few research methods that can convert any relational database into a graph database, and most of them are based on a specific field data set to build a relational database, and then perform simple conversion through the characteristics of the data set.Aiming at this problem, a universal conversion method is proposed. Firstly, converted the most basic component tables name, records, and fields in the relational database into labels, nodes, and corresponding attributes of the nodes under the graph database; secondly, used the intermediate connection table method to convert the foreign keys in the relational database into the relationship of a graph database between the nodes; then some constraint issues in relational databases, such as multiple primary key issues, indexes, and no default values, were optimized to form a final graph database model that met expectations; finally, Realized the effective migration of large quantities of data in the relational database to the constructed graph database model. In the experiment, the above method was used to successfully convert a relational database to a graph database, and the database construction, data import, SQL query and Cypher language query were performed for the database before and after the conversion, and through the analysis and comparison of data integrity, time cost, result validity,which shows that the integrity and operability of the database before and after conversion are consistent, and the data processing efficiency of the database is much higher than that of the relational database, which verifies that the method in this paper is feasible.

articleTitle: External validation of a deep learning prediction model for in-hospital mortality among ICU patients
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With increasing hospital adoption of electronic health record (EHR) systems worldwide, a massive amount of EHR data are generated in intensive care practice, and deep learning models are increasingly applied in mortality prediction. However, due to the lack of external validation, it’s difficult to generalize the deep learning models in critical care settings. Our previous work proposed a routinely collected data based deep learning model for intensive care unit (ICU) mortality prediction. This study aimed to externally validate the model using a cohort from the published MIMIC III data set so as to examine the generalizability and feasibility of the model. With little changed in the modeling, the deep learning based model achieved a high accuracy (AUROC=0.90; AUPRC=0.70), and good calibration properties which was reflected by a brier score of 0.070, in the external validation database. The model’ excellent performance in our external validation cohort provides more evidence for the application of the deep learning model in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Personalized Home BESS Recommender System Based on Neural Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Battery energy storage systems have been becoming increasingly prevalent in residential sector. With more and more home battery energy storage system (HBESS) products appeared in the market, it would be difficult for the users to choose the most suitable battery product from the market. This paper proposes a personalized HBESS recommender system that provides decision-making support to residential users by recommending suitable HBESSs to them. The system integrates a neural collaborative filtering technique, which uses a General Matrix Factorization (GMF) model and a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) neural network to infer the target user’s preferences on different HBESS products through analyzing the preference trends of a group of the target user’s similar users on a set of HBESS products. Based on this, the system generated a recommendation list of HBESS products to the target user. Numerical simulations based on real-world data are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed system.

articleTitle: The impact of digital service level on the trade openness in Chinese cities where China-Europe railway express is operating
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The new digital technology has constantly strengthened the global economy and trade system. Based on the new generation of digital technology, it is capable of being applied to extensive fields through the digital service industry. In this paper, digital service level of seventeen provinces that have opened China-Europe Railway Express from 2011 to 2020 are assessed using principal component analysis (PCA). The empirical multiple regression discoveries that the enhancement in digital service level could increase export volume. In addition, both postal and telecommunications investment in towns and cities (PAT) and the number of patent applications in high-tech industries (PAH) interact with the level of digital service to facilitate trade development. Moreover, China’s “National Informatization Development Strategy Outline” policy promulgated in 2016 positively promotes digital service levels, which in turn promotes export trade. This paper also gives suggestions to enhance trade openness of cities around CR railway in the digital field.

articleTitle: Research on AHP-EWM based distribution network equipment interest rate portfolio evaluation method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The current distribution network equipment utilization rate still lacks a comprehensive evaluation method, and the indexes are redundant and large in the calculation. In this paper, considering the influencing factors such as power supply reliability, network structure, load supply capacity and load characteristics, we construct a 1 Based on the hierarchical analysis method and the improved entropy weight method, a comprehensive evaluation method with a combination of subjective and objective is constructed; finally, the equipment utilization rate of a medium voltage distribution network in Guangdong is evaluated. The calculation results show that the method can effectively evaluate the utilization rate of distribution network equipment and provide a reference basis for improving the economy of the power grid, power grid planning and renovation work.

articleTitle: Hybrid Artificial Immune System for Controlled Procedural Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Although powerful in automatic generation of complex geometric structures, procedural modeling is also known to be notoriously difficult in controlling. Various attempts have been made to address the issue in a reverse manner, solving for grammars and parameters of a procedural model to satisfy given target constraints. However, these attempts are suffered from high time cost. In this paper, we present a novel method for controlled procedural modeling, with Artificial Immune System (AIS) as the basis of the framework. By imitating the mechanism of biological immune response, the framework evolvs a set of individual models towards more intuitive high-level goals, such as a volume to be filled with a tree produced procedurally or a silhouette to be matched by a procedurally produced city’s skyline. These goals are intuitive and could be easily specified by artists. Compared with existing solutions, our AIS based framework shows faster convergence than Stochastically-Ordered Sequential Monte Carlo (SOSMC) based method, generates better models than Reversible Jump Markov Chain Monte Carlo (RJMCMC) based work in the long run, and has greater potential in GPU parallelization than Genetic Algorithm (GA) based framework.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis of Intelligent Emotion Recognition Based on ECG Signal Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: ECG signals appear more and more frequently in people’s lives. Through ECG signals, we can learn some of the most basic physiological information of the human body. Through the physiological information, we can analyze and diagnose the physiological condition of the patient. In addition, the portability of ECG measurement equipment also provides researchers with more possibilities. This article discusses the design scheme of ECG front-end analog circuits, combines the obtained results with the cutting-edge theory of emotion recognition, and proposes the advantages and disadvantages of different circuit design schemes and algorithms. This article also analyzes the specific parameters of circuit design and the comparison of data processing algorithms, aiming to explore more applications of ECG signals in the field of emotion recognition.

articleTitle: A Method for Modeling the Neural Network for Term Extraction Based on Bilingual Sentence Alignment Corpus
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The implementation of the current term extraction model is mainly dependent on the training on manual tagging of a bilingual term corpus. It will take a great amount of manpower to tag terms in a massive corpus. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a method for modeling the neural network for term extraction based on bilingual sentence alignment corpus, which implies that GIZA++ is used to tag terms in terms of bilingual word alignment based on bilingual sentence alignment corpus, thus generating the tagged corpus for bilingual word alignment as the initial training input of neural network. In order to fully explore the potential language features between sentences, from the perspective of deep learning, an unsupervised training algorithm for word alignment based on Word2vec training word vector and integrated into the neural network was proposed. The experiment was carried out based on English-Chinese patent and standard sentence alignment corpus, with an accuracy of 0.8662.

articleTitle: Intelligent transportation big data retrieval algorithm based on blockchain and aggregation signature
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In view of the low retrieval efficiency of data ciphertext and the insecurity of centralized database in the current intelligent transportation big data system, this paper introduces the blockchain technology into the intelligent transportation big data system, and each information collection department stores it in the blockchain after normalization according to the data standard. According to the unmodifiability and traceability of the blockchain, the trustworthiness and transparency of the data in the system can be guaranteed, The system is better than the current mainstream scheme in data sharing. In this paper, an efficient ciphertext retrieval algorithm scheme for data in intelligent transportation big data system based on blockchain technology is proposed. Based on the theories of bilinear yangshe and difficulty hypothesis theory in cryptography, the problem of low efficiency of multi keyword and multi ciphertext retrieval in large database on traditional platform is solved, This paper uses the aggregation signature algorithm to improve the ciphertext retrieval efficiency in the big data system. For multiple keyword retrieval conditions, an aggregation key is generated by the aggregation signature key algorithm, and the aggregation trap is generated with the aggregation key, retrieval keyword and retrieval file set as inputs for ciphertext retrieval, The final result of the retrieval is based on the smart contract technology of the blockchain to verify the effectiveness of the data and ensure the integrity of the data. In Chapter 4, the security and performance of the efficient aggregation signature retrieval algorithm are analyzed. The results show that the key generated by the aggregation signature is safe and reliable, the aggregation trap used in ciphertext retrieval is irreversibly regenerated, and the algorithm is verified to be trusted in terms of security. The simulation results show that the algorithm is better than other literature algorithms in terms of time overhead, effectively reduces the system overhead and improves the retrieval efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Quantum Coins for Non-Power-of-Two States - Implementation and Performance on Quantum Walk and Quantum Walk Search Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Quantum coin is an essential element of the discrete-time quantum walk, the quantum analog of random walk. Most existing papers relating to quantum coin discussed the implementation and performance of the coin on power-of-two states and degrees of graphs. In this paper, I proposed and analyzed three alternative coins–binary state coin, W state coin, and Walsh-Hadamard coin–that possessed the property to perform on all states and degrees of graphs. I discussed the implementation and the performance of the three coins in the application of Quantum Walk and Quantum Walk Search. I compared and discussed the advantages, disadvantages, and errors of the three coins on a quantum simulator and a NISQ computer (i.e. IBM Q). In the end, I presented further applications for the three coins in quantum-walk-based algorithms and other potential topics in quantum computing.

articleTitle: Research of Virtual Simulation Experiment Course Resource Intelligent Information System Construction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to enable the construction of virtual simulation experiment resources in colleges and universities to keep up with the development of professional technology, this paper proposes to build a “diversified virtual simulation experiment teaching resource construction system” through exploration and research. With the help of virtual reality, AR, panoramic roaming, video and other technologies, it provides a unified development framework, development documents and case templates for professional teachers to independently develop virtual simulation experiment teaching resources in line with undergraduate teaching, and helps teachers quickly build virtual simulation experiment resources in accordance with unified standards. It effectively solves the problems that it is difficult for college teachers to independently develop virtual simulation courseware and the technology is not unified.

articleTitle: Human Pose Estimation Based on Multi-branch Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of the convolutional neural network, significant progress has been made in human pose estimation. Recent human pose estimation approaches adopt a single branch network, which can only provide limited surveillance information. Aiming at the problem, we propose to adopt a multi-branch network for both 2D human pose estimation and 3D human pose estimation. Leading results on multiple datasets verify the effectiveness of our multi-branch network.

articleTitle: Intelligent Prediction System of Process Parameters in Complex Workshop Based on ABPNN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the improvement of workshop production process, the complexity of workshop production is also increasing, which intensifies the difficulty of workshop process parameter prediction. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes a workshop process parameter prediction model based on ABPNN algorithm. Aiming at the multi index data of complex workshop, the Pearson correlation coefficient is used to analyze the correlation of workshop process parameters, judge the correlation between the parameters to be predicted and various influencing factors according to the Pearson correlation coefficient, and realize the reduction of prediction parameters. On this basis, Adam algorithm is introduced to establish a learning rate adaptive optimization algorithm based on transfer learning to dynamically adjust the network structure, The reasonable model parameters are solved to improve the prediction accuracy of the model. Through the actual workshop production data as an example, the results show that compared with the traditional BP neural network, the model has certain advantages in prediction accuracy and running speed.

articleTitle: A Study of Environmental Protection Planning Method and Environmental Risk Assessment of Regional Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of national economy and continuous enhancement of people's living standards, the subject concerning environmental protection has become more and more important. In recent years, there has been a contradiction in how to make good use of resource while protecting environment, and that has become an important problem constraining economic growth. Therefore, as the premise of economic development, environmental protection is the basic requirement in adjustment of economic structure and development way for the country. The construction of power grid has provided a strong guarantee and made great contributions to the steady development of social economy and the improvement of people's living standards, however, some problems concerning environment have also been caused in this process. Based on the analysis of background and meaning of power grid environmental protection planning, the research content is determined. According to the identification of key environmental influencing factors in power grid planning, this paper makes analysis of environmental protection planning method of regional power grid, as well as makes a study of indicator system of environmental risk assessment, raising an environmental risk assessment method of regional power grid based on P-S-R framework indicator system. This method is to overlap environmental sensitive areas based on data, present the environmental impact of power grid planning on cities in a vivid way, and correct some errors in the traditional assessment method. Based on a full analysis of regional environmental protection data, the environmental risk prediction value is obtained. The environmental risk assessment of regional power grid is carried out with examples. From the results, this method can guide the engineering application of regional power grid environmental protection planning in an overall objective and scientific way, as well as provide a theoretical reference for the research of environmental risk assessment.

articleTitle: Study on Modeling and Measurement Technology of Dynamic Reactive Power Compensation Device for Renewable Energy Station
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: At present, the measurement and Modeling Research of power system mainly focuses on generator, excitation system, prime mover and its regulation system, power load and so on. However, there is relatively little research on the measured modeling of dynamic reactive power compensation device. In the simulation calculation of power system, the dynamic reactive power compensation device usually adopts a highly simplified model, or even ignores it. The accuracy and applicability of the model are limited, which directly affects the reactive power voltage regulation capacity of renewable energy stations and the consumption of renewable energy. Acceptance. There are great differences in the characteristics of the actual equipment, which may lead to the inconsistency between the calculation results and the actual situation, the relevant power grid planning and operation will lose the basis, and the power grid operation will face great hidden dangers. In the field of field measurement and modeling of power system, the dynamic reactive power compensation device of renewable energy station lacks field measurement and modeling technology, which can not meet the requirements of accurate modeling of power system and safe and stable operation of large power grid The operation of power grid will face great hidden dangers. It is urgent to study the model and parameter technology of dynamic reactive power compensation device in renewable energy station.

articleTitle: Multi-kernel Fusion Pooling and Linear Convolution Kernel for Retinal Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Retinal Image Segmentation is an important part of Medical image. In terms of taking advantage of the characteristics of retinal vessel width changes as well as the local linear feature, in this article, we propose ML-Net, a new model based on U-Net, with the ability to find the linear feature of retinal vessels. ML-Net mainly contains two major blocks: a multi-kernel fusion pooling (MFP) block to preserve spatial information and a linear convolution kernel (LCK) block to capture more strip information. Both blocks are lightweight and can serve as efficient plug-and-play modules in existing scene parsing networks. We apply the proposed ML-Net to three mainstream data sets, namely DRIVE, CHASE-DBI, and STARE. The comprehensive results show that the proposed method outperforms the original U-Net and other state-of-the-art methods for retinal image segmentation.

articleTitle: Towards Advanced Resource Management and User-friendly Delivery in Blended Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous need for advanced education in today’s society, many education platforms have emerged to make it more efficient for the populace to get their hands-on educational resources. However, the approach of these educational platforms is based on the same model as face-to-face learning, i.e., it takes an entire subject to perhaps get an answer for a trivial problem hidden within all that noise. People do not have access to a learning platform that can quickly provide them with the resources they desire, and it is also challenging to find a platform with open educational resources. Our group aims to provide a blended learning resource management platform (BLRMP) that covers these deficiencies. This proposal details the description, work plan, objective, human resources, progress monitoring and proposed budget of the BLRMP project.

articleTitle: Development of electrochemical energy storage and application in power grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Energy storage technology plays an important role in power grid operation as an important part of regulating power grid quality and stabilizing microgrid structure. In order to make the energy storage technology better serve the power grid, this paper first briefly introduces several types of energy storage, and then elaborates on several chemical energy storage: lead energy storage, lithium battery energy storage, sodium sulfur battery and liquid flow battery. Based on the analysis of the advantages and disadvantages, development, research status and chemical properties of the four kinds of electrochemical energy storage, some suggestions and ideas for the future development of electrochemical energy storage are put forward. Finally, the development trend of energy storage is forecasted.

articleTitle: A Text Analysis Method of Risk-taking Attitude and the Computer Assisted Intelligent Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: We distinguish the difference between the ability and attitude of corporate risk-taking, and innovatively put forward a method to measure the corporate risk-taking attitude based on the tone of the textual risk disclosure. We apply this method to the analyse annual report samples of Listed Companies in 2018. It shows that companies with a positive attitude are far more than those that are not. The non-state-owned companies have more positive risk-taking attitude than the state-owned companies, and the high-tech companies have more positive risk-taking attitude than the ordinary companies. These findings are consistent with our forecast. Our measurement method of risk-taking attitude has a good effect.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Real-Time Market Dispatching Equivalent Model of Micro-Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the decreasing cost of renewable energy generation, micro-grid will be used more and more widely. In this paper, the dispatching equivalent model of micro-grid participating in the real-time equilibrium dispatching of local energy market is studied, which provides the basis for the global optimal dispatching of local energy system. Firstly, a mathematical model of micro-grid real-time dispatching equivalent is established based on incomplete information of micro-grid agent and aiming at the minimum total real-time dispatching cost in the dispatching cycle. Secondly, a data-driven method of real-time dispatching equivalent model based on A3C deep reinforcement learning algorithm is proposed. Finally, it is verified by case study that the data-driven deep reinforcement learning method is effective and advanced in solving the equivalent modeling of micro-grid real-time dispatching. It can provide a scientific basis for the distribution power distribution market dispatching under multi-market agents and incomplete information environment.

articleTitle: Low-Frequency Coupling Resonance Suppression Method of PLL-based Current Controlled Inverter Based on Coordinated Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The increasing penetration of new energy generation has made the stability of the power system challenging at the same time. The current-controlled inverter based on phase-locked-loop synchronization (PLL-CCI) is prone to interactive coupling with the power grid, triggering low-frequency coupling resonance. In order to suppress the low-frequency coupling resonance of PLL-CCI, this paper firstly derives a stability analysis model based on the coupled sequence admittance to reveal the mechanism of low-frequency coupling resonance. Then a coordinated control method based on q-axis voltage feedforward and PCC voltage feedforward is proposed, using q-axis voltage feedforward to weaken the negative effect of PLL bandwidth on stability and using PCC voltage feedforward to improve the small-signal synchronization stability of PLL-CCI. It is applied to the PLL-CCI grid-connected system and the theoretical analysis shows that the control method can improve the stability of the system while ensuring the PLL response speed, and the method also realizes the decoupling design of control parameters, which has practical engineering application value. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified by experiments on a semi-physical simulation platform.

articleTitle: Algorithm Research on Fuzzy Test Method of CAN Bus Based on Field Weight
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The communication network in the vehicle, especially the CAN bus network, is under serious security threat. The security of CAN bus network can be improved by fuzzy test technology. At present, there is little research on the fuzzy test technology of automobile can bus. The test case generation method mostly adopts the random generation method, without considering the application layer protocol format of CAN bus, which reduces the passing rate of CAN bus message, It affects the efficiency of fuzzy testing. This paper compares the advantages and disadvantages of the fuzzy testing algorithm based on the improved wgan-gp and the fuzzy testing algorithm based on the field weight. Both algorithms can find the vulnerabilities in the CAN bus and affect the vehicle to produce abnormal response. The fuzzy testing algorithm based on the improved wgan-gp has shorter discovery time and response time and better effect.

articleTitle: Intelligent forecasting electric vehicle purchase model based on logistic and multi-objective optimization model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article first preprocesses the data, uses MATLAB software, finds out the missing values in the data and processes them, finds outliers and handles them through the distance-based anomaly detection method; Secondly, the dimensionality of the sample is reduced, and multiple variables of the sample are reduced by lasso regression, and then Logistic regression analysis is performed on the selected variables; Third, establish a logistic regression prediction model for electric vehicles, and evaluate the excellence of the model according to the results of deviance test, Pearson test, model AIC, BIC, -2logL criterion, likelihood ratio test and Wald test, and conclude that the model passes deviance Check, and the P value is equal to 1,The model passed the goodness-of-fit test. The values of AIC, BIC, and -2log L are smaller than the model with only constant terms, and the P value of the likelihood ratio test and Wald test is less than 0.0001, indicating that the overall fit is good; Finally, an optimization model with the objective function of the least difficulty in improvement (the smallest improvement in experience points) was constructed, and potential customers were analyzed. Lingo software was used to solve the optimization model, it is concluded that the probability of purchase by customers can be increased by increasing the economic satisfaction score of about 4%.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Design of Multifunctional pedal-actuated wheelchair for locomotion and rehabilitation training
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Patients with lower limb disabilities have caused a great burden both to society and themselves. The combination of wheelchair and cycling achieves both locomotion and rehabilitation training at the same time, which meets their needs. This paper presents a new multifunctional electric wheelchair with a rehabilitation training module based on our previous research. We remove the exoskeleton and replace it with the leg structure of the user to form a crank-rocker mechanism. The rehabilitation module can now be adjusted forward and backward or hidden under the wheelchair completely. We also replace the force sensors with software to detect users’ intentions. A new friendly human-computer interface is designed to enable users to control the wheelchair easier. Experiments are conducted on several volunteers. Meanwhile, more than 100 people in a hospital and a nursing home have tried our product, which obtains a high praise rate. Experiment data is presented and analyzed to test the functions of the new design, and results show that our design can meet the need for rehabilitation and locomotion of different people.

articleTitle: Table of Contents
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Presents the table of contents/splash page of the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Purchasing Model for Inter-provincial Power Transaction Considering the Comprehensive Energy Market in the Province
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to promote the large-scale optimal allocation of power resources, the state is vigorously building an inter-provincial and intra-provincial power market. In the existing optimal power purchase model for the two-level power market, the intra-provincial power trading model does not consider the impact of the integrated energy market in the province on inter-provincial power trading, which leads to a lack of rationality in inter-provincial power trading decisions. Therefore, this paper proposes an optimal power purchase model for interprovincial power transactions considering the comprehensive energy market in the province. This model will consider intraprovincial power transactions and interprovincial power transactions in the integrated energy market as the upper and lower levels of the power purchase model. Secondly, use Karush Kuhn Tucker (KKT) conditions and duality theory to convert the two-level optimization model to a linear single-layer model. Finally, an example of interprovincial transactions verifies the rationality of the proposed method and its advantages in clearing prices.

articleTitle: Research on an Edge Computing Architecture for Industrial Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In response to the industry’s new needs for intelligent production, networked collaboration, personalized customization, and service-oriented transformation, this article studies on the special functions and performance indicators that edge computing equipment should have when applied in industry, proposes how to effectively use the open network, computing, and storage capabilities of edge computing at different network levels to provide an edge computing architecture that provides nearby edge intelligent services to be applied in industry. Taking the industrial process control optimization scenario as an example, the different uses of three edge computing devices are described, and the problems that can be solved by the application of industrial edge computing are explained. The industrial edge computing architecture described in this article can realize the cross-level transmission of data and provide an open and unified modeling capability for edge computing data, which is suitable for the design of new edge intelligent application scenarios in different industrial fields.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent supervision and visualization of big data on the flow and direction of veterinary drug
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Visual display and dynamic analysis of big data on the flow and direction of veterinary drug is an important means of veterinary drug supervision. This research established a display method of the spatial distribution pattern of veterinary drug, innovated a visualization technology and developed an intelligent management and visual display platform of big data on the flow and direction of veterinary drug. The platform realized the integrated management of big data on the flow and direction of veterinary drug, and provided comprehensive decision support information and visual services for the intelligent supervision of veterinary drug.

Author Keywords: Flow and direction of veterinary drug

articleTitle: Research on uniform interface technology of radiotherapy equipment based on edge computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article starts with the introduction of data integration problems in the current radiotherapy process, analyzes the composition of the various systems involved in the radiotherapy process, provides a method for constructing a radiotherapy equipment data dictionary and a unified information model for the radiotherapy process, and provides a common semantic specification for data integration during the radiotherapy process. This research is helpful to realize the real-time collection and transmission of key information of radiotherapy equipment based on edge computing, realize the sharing of medical information on a larger scale, realize the comprehensive utilization of data in the process of radiotherapy to a greater extent, and improve the digitalized and networked level in the overall treatment process of radiotherapy.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of RFID-Based Chronometer System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper combines C# programming, RFID technology and database technology to design a set of automatic timing system for middle and long distance running software. The system is composed of many subsystems, such as information management of test students, reading and management of RFID card, automatic timing processing and statistical analysis data. It can realize the identification, reading and automatic timing of the test students who wear RFID card, and upload the timing data to the database to save and export, and get the test results of the students, realizing automation. Compared with manual timing, can save a lot of manpower and material resources; Compared with the general carpet antenna automatic timing, the equipment is simpler and the cost is lower. Moreover, the error of the test results can also be within a required range, which can meet the basic test requirements of middle and long-distance running, and is suitable for military physical fitness testing and training of middle and long-distance running in colleges and universities.

Author Keywords: Middle and long distance running test

articleTitle: Application Demonstration of Vehicular Network System Based on 5G Smart Park
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As a key entry point for constructing a smart city, 5G smart park is characterized by relatively single traffic elements and clear business requirements, which is conducive to the realization of 5G+C-V2X commercialization. 5G network can bring network access conditions of Enhanced Mobile Broadband, Ultra-Reliable and Low Latency Communications and Massive Machine Type Communication for traffic groups in the park. This paper firstly analyzes the characteristics of the 5G network and the actual demand of traffic groups in the smart park. On this basis, we propose an intelligent vehicle network system based on 5G+C-V2X, which can provide a variety of intelligent traffic innovation technologies and business demonstrations. This system can be used to provide vehicle-road-cloud-network intelligent transportation services in multiple scenarios during the Winter Olympics. This can be an opportunity to create industrial benchmark cases of 5G innovation business, which effectively lead the industrial innovation of intelligent vehicle networking and promote better and faster development of the global Internet of Vehicles industry.

articleTitle: An intelligent tension sensor for high speed railway catenary monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: High speed railway catenary is an important infrastructure of high-speed railway, and its safety is related to the passenger life and property safety. This paper proposed a tension sensor that can be used for on-line monitoring of high-speed railway catenary. The sensor uses solar cells to supply power and sends the measured tension data to the terminal for monitoring by wireless module. The results show that, The measuring range of our tension sensor is 30kN, and the measurement accuracy can reach 2.1% F.S.. Also, our tension sensor has passed the lateral slip test of 3kN, which is a necessary experiment for the installation of high-speed rail lines.

articleTitle: Substation Condition Evaluation Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of the power industry, as an important part of the power industry, it is very necessary to accurately evaluate the overall operation state of the substation. This paper proposes a method to evaluate the substation state based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, establishes the index system to evaluate the substation state and the operation state of different levels of the substation, and finally completes the evaluation of the key state by extracting the membership degree between the key equipment and parameters of the substation. The example shows that the comprehensive evaluation method of substation state based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process can effectively and accurately evaluate the operation state of substation.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Parking Spaces in Open-air Parking Lots
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article introduces the research on how to comprehensively consider various factors to design the parking space of the parking lot, so that it can obtain a larger parking capacity. This article solves the following three problems by establishing a nonlinear integer programming model, combined with multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. Question 1: Establish three single-row parking models for parallel, vertical, and inclined parking, a nonlinear integer programming model, establish a multi-row parking space distribution model, and further discuss and solve the three situations. Question 2: In the case of restricting the entrance and exit position, this article introduces the division of the parking lot into a rectangular area and a trapezoidal area. For the rectangular area, the nonlinear integer programming model is solved. Question 3: Without limiting the location of entrances and exits, this article first combines the internal and external road conditions of the parking lot and the parking lot in the design principle to obtain the location and number of entrances and exits, and solve the corresponding problems.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Intelligent Monitoring System on Data Middle Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the construction and operation of the Data Middle Platform, more and more operation, log and alarm information are generated in the daily operation and maintenance process. Due to the rapid increase of various log information data, this information often cannot be understood in time, and due to separation of the platform and the discreteness of data, these information are not conducive to identification, aggregation, unification and management timely, with the number of applications and usage of the platform are increasing, and these problems will increasingly affect the normal operation of the platform. Through the research and application of platform monitoring warning tools, the automatic collection and rapid push of information are realized, and the early warning monitoring, judgment and processing of problems can be carried out in real time, eliminating potential safety hazards, and ensuring the safe and stable operation of the platform and system.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis and Computer Intelligent Evaluation Model of Land Quality Grade in Leibo
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to fully understand the quality grade of cultivated land in Leibo County, Sichuan Province, the county cultivated land resource management information system was used to carry out the evaluation of cultivated land quality grade in the league, comprehensively mastered the distribution of cultivated land quality grade in each banner (county and city), and improved the big data of cultivated land resources. The results show that the average cultivated land quality grade of the league in 2020 is 7. 95.According to different quality grades of cultivated land, this paper puts forward measures to protect cultivated land quality and improve soil fertility according to local conditions.

articleTitle: EPC Wind Power Engineering Risk Assessment System Based on Bayesian Fault Tree
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The management level of engineering contracting system in China cannot adapt to the upgrading of production capacity industry, in the process of international integration. In order to change this situation, China’s engineering contracting system needs to be comprehensively upgraded. The EPC project management mode perfectly meets the needs of the current engineering management field, so it is the main development direction of engineering management mode in the future. Starting from the modern EPC project management, this paper designs a complete set of EPC project management system from the aspects of risk identification, risk analysis, risk response and risk monitoring management of the project, and on this basis, puts forward the engineering risk assessment strategy based on Bayesian fault tree, and carries out the informatization risk management and control of wind power projects from the perspective of intelligence. On this basis, a set of processes and corresponding wind control systems are designed for EPC risk response and risk monitoring, which solves the key problem of current engineering management fundamentally.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Animal Medical Interaction APP Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Based on the development status of medical apps in the market and the actual needs of animal medical treatment, an Android-based animal medical interaction system platform is proposed. The design idea, development model, main functional modules and the design and implementation of key technologies of the system are described. The system implements the establishment of Tomcat server and the configuration of MySQL database, and uses Http Client to realize the information exchange between medical client and server. The system provides an interactive platform for farmers and experts, and the collected information will provide necessary data for intelligent interaction in the next step.

articleTitle: FMCI: An EDF-VD-based flexible mixed-criticality task scheduling method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: At present, mixed-criticality systems have become the development trend of embedded systems, such as in power edge computing, avionics safety control and car safety driving scenarios. In the existing advanced flexible mixed-criticality (FMC) model, the method of calculating compensation requirements may have a large number of low-criticality invalid compensation, which will greatly reduce the overall performance of low-criticality tasks. In response to this problem, our paper improves the method of reducing the service level of low-criticality tasks, from reducing the execution time of low-criticality tasks to now extending the period of low-criticality tasks, and proposes the corresponding FMCI-EDF-VD scheduling algorithm. Experimental results show that flexible mixed criticality improved (FMCI) model can manage the decline in service levels of low-criticality tasks more wisely and reduce invalid compensation for low-criticality tasks. Compared with existing FMC, our method can always perform better in ensuring the completion of high-criticality tasks while scheduling more low-criticality tasks under different circumstances.

articleTitle: Architecture of airborne missile health intelligent management system based on knowledge service
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Airborne missile health management system is a comprehensive management system which covers the whole life cycle status monitoring, diagnosis and prediction of various systems, subsystems and components of airborne missile, and then makes decision support for airborne missile maintenance and support. From the existing literature, there are few reports on the platform construction, operation mode and knowledge service of airborne missile health management. In order to effectively improve airborne missile health status cognition and knowledge management ability construction level, the operation service mode of health management platform is studied, and the resources in airborne missile health management field are integrated, and a knowledge-based service oriented airborne missile health management system architecture is constructed.

articleTitle: A Bit Level Erasure Codes Solution Based on Galois Field
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The storage system has to use Galois Field to do CODEC because the massive data requirement. But the multiplication and division operation in Galois Field is different from the normal. So an extra hardware module is always designed to solve this problem which added to the data path slowed the transmission and also cost extra area. We proposed a bit level erasure codes solution in this paper to improve the erasure code’s CODEC replaced the Galois Field LUT module to a matrix. With the matrix the data operation can work in bit level only by selection and exclusive-or. With the hardware with Reed-Solomon codes Vandermonde and Cauchy, we can find the speed advantages trade off the cost of area by our solution.

articleTitle: Realization and Application of Real-time Multi-channel Wireless Pressure Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the pointer or digital instrument of the hydraulic device can only display the instantaneous value, which brings inconvenience to the detection, monitoring, operation and maintenance of the hydraulic device, we design a real-time multi-channel wireless pressure detection system. The system consists of silicon piezoresistive pressure sensor, wireless pressure detection unit, data acquisition controller, system power supply lithium battery, wireless receiver, and remote monitoring center. The silicon piezoresistive pressure sensor collect the information, which is processed by the wireless pressure detection unit and then transmit that to the remote monitoring center. The display interface can display the pressure curve of the detection part and the ideal curve in real time, based on this, we can analyze and judge the pressure of the device under test. After testing, we have realized real-time acquisition and transmission of 4-channel pressure data, waveform display and storage on the hydraulic excavator, which facilitate equipment debugging, maintenance, and troubleshooting, and achieve the expected results.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Intelligent “Internet + Idle Items” Mobile Network Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: According to the online questionnaire survey, 63.4% of students are willing to buy idle items, because idle items on campus tend to be repeatable and timeliness, and have low prices, which can greatly save costs. From this point of view, it is of great practical significance to construct a specialized college students’ idle goods trading platform to meet the needs of college students. Aiming at the vacancy and deficiency of the application platform of idle items trading and service in campus, the Internet + campus idle items trading and service platform based on H5 is researched and developed by using HTML5 mobile development technology. The platform includes back-end system management and front-end APP application, and provides an efficient mobile service platform for idle items release, transaction and service for teachers and students on campus. Combined with the characteristics of goods trading on campus, with the starting point of facilitating transactions and serving teachers and students, the traditional flea market is transformed into a convenient and fast mobile trading and service platform of “Internet + campus idle goods”, which is of great significance to the school and teachers and students.

articleTitle: Safe and Effective Elliptic Curve Cryptography Algorithm against Power Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Having high safety and effective computational property, the elliptic curve cryptosystem is very suitable for embedded mobile environment with resource constraints. Power attack is a powerful cipher attack method, it uses leaking information of cipher-chip in its operation process to attack chip cryptographic algorithms. In view of the situation that the power attack on the elliptic curve cryptosystem mainly concentrates on scalar multiplication operation an improved algorithm FWNAF based on RWNAF is proposed. This algorithm utilizes the fragments window technology further improves the utilization ratio of the storage resource and reduces the “jitter phenomenon” in system computing performance caused by the sharp change in system resources.

articleTitle: Research on the Application Ability of Mathematical Modeling and Software Simulation under Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The thesis first collects data through questionnaire surveys, and conducts statistical analysis of the reasons why students have insufficient application ability in mathematical modeling. The purpose is to understand students’ modeling ability and the root cause of their problems, to correct the problem, prescribe the right remedy and propose solutions for the next step. The method prepares the theoretical basis. Secondly, the article designs and implements a Spark-based mathematical modeling analysis modeling system for college students. The system realizes the adaptive collection and offline and online analysis and processing of structured, semi-structured and unstructured data through five modules: data acquisition, data storage, data analysis, data management and data application. The research results found that the proposed system can achieve effective and accurate clustering of specific scene data of college students’ mathematical modeling, and can meet the speed and accuracy of big data processing.

articleTitle: Application of Internet Remote Video Technology in Learning Motivation Intensity under Smart Cloud Platform Service
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Cloud services are an increasing, using, and delivery model of Internet-based related services, which usually involve the provision of dynamic, easy-scalable and often virtualized resources through the Internet. In this study, researchers discuss students’ learning motivation intensity in cohort study under the smart cloud platform service and the motivation-behavior gap that influence Chinese students’ second language learning in smart cloud platform service.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Dispatching Operation Management System Based on “Internet +” Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The power system is mainly to provide customers with safe and stable power energy supply services, and the efficient and stable operation of the power system is the basic guarantee of high-quality services, which requires both quality and efficiency in the operation and maintenance management of the power system. For power system operation and maintenance management, distribution network dispatching operation management is the focus, and its stability and reliability are very important. The innovation and application of Internet + technology further enhance the intelligent level of distribution network dispatching and operation. Also, it brings the high quality and efficiency of power operation and maintenance management by the application of advanced distribution network dispatching operation management system. This study mainly discussed the construction and application of distribution network dispatching operation management system based on Internet + technology, defined its main components, and analyzed its specific application benefits, thus offering guidance and reference for intelligent control of distribution network dispatching operation.

articleTitle: Innovation method optimization of digital platform enabler based on correlation analysis and gray prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Starting from the perspective of architecture design, this paper takes Alibaba Cloud IoT platform, Haier U+ platform and Huawei OceanConnect platform as case studies, and uses correlation analysis and gray prediction methods to explore how digital platforms can effectively empower complementary users to achieve digital innovation. It is found that modularity, stratification and platform boundary resource dynamics are the key dimensions of digital platform architecture design, and the key dimensions of digital platform architecture design are extracted to reveal the enabling mechanism of digital platform architecture design for complementarity innovation, which can provide a new idea for digital platform enabling complementarity innovation based on architecture design.

articleTitle: A Survey of Deep Learning Target Detection Algorithms under Candidate Regions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Target detection is a research hotspot in the field of computer vision. The target detection algorithm based on candidate regions has high accuracy, but the structure is complex, and the detection speed is slow. The regression-based target detection algorithm has simple structure and fast detection speed, and it is in real-time target detection The field has high application value, but the detection accuracy is relatively low. Based on this research background, this paper first analyses the mechanism of shadow generation, understands the characteristics of shadows and human visual characteristics, and summarizes and classifies the current existing features. Based on the similar shadow detection algorithm, a shadow detection algorithm based on the RGB colour model is proposed. The algorithm in this paper is verified through experiments. The article proves that the algorithm can detect and remove the shadows of moving targets well.

articleTitle: Evaluation Algorithm of Construction Project Safety Management Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: At present, China’s construction market has achieved competitive bidding at home and abroad, and more and more construction projects are determined by bidding. Although the development and application of new building technologies have solved many technical difficulties in engineering construction, construction projects are not only characterized by complex construction technologies, but also by large investment funds, long construction period, many participants and complex construction environment factors. The construction industry is also prone to safety accidents, which is one of the characteristics of the construction industry. Especially under the condition of non-standard and unscientific construction accident control and management, the annual losses caused by construction accidents are very huge, which also restricts the development process of China’s construction industry. This paper uses the bid evaluation model of BP neural network algorithm to evaluate the safety management of construction project.

articleTitle: Research and Algorithm Optimization on the Intelligent Color Selection of Mosaic Tiles through RGB Color model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Mosaic is one of the oldest known decorative arts, and it is widely used for its small, exquisite and colorful features. However, because of the heavy workload of manual color selection, this article has modeled, solved and analyzed the color selection problem of mosaic tiles. In the actual research process, this project will disassemble it into three directions for separate research. The first direction is mainly to study how to find the closest tile color to each color to calculate and analyze the color difference. In this direction, We have established a LAB color model and an RGB color model for solution and comparison. The second direction mainly studies the optimization problems related to color coverage. In this direction, we establish an RGB color model, use random simulation methods to find the new color points that meet the requirements, and then the center of the point set composed of the original 22 colors The coordinates are always kept at (128,128,128). Considering the abundance of colors locally, a greedy algorithm model is established. Finally, the results of the two models are comprehensively evaluated, and appropriate new colors are selected. The third direction mainly studies how to balance the cost and the performance effect. In this direction, based on the ten new colors obtained in the second question, we evaluate the dispersion degree of the point distribution in the space and conduct a series of analyses in combination with the cost.

articleTitle: Mathematical Statistics and Big Data Analysis of Efficacy of Wenjing Decoction with Electro-Acupuncture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Objective: The purpose of the research was to observe the clinical efficacy of Wenjing decoction (decoction for warming meridians) in treating Raynaud’s syndromes (RNDs). Methods: One hundred of RND patients treated in the hospital were randomly divided into four treatment groups separately receiving tanshinone injection, electro-acupuncture (EA), cinepazide maleate injection, and Wenjing decoction to treat the RNDs. The changes in the symptoms and the contents of endothelin-1 (ET-1) and nitric oxide (NO) in the blood plasma of patients in the four groups were observed and compared, as well as changes in the cold water immersion tests and handgrip tests. Results: Patients in the four groups all improved greatly after treatment with significant efficacy (P < 0.05). The intergroup comparison showed that patients in the four groups did not have significant differences before treatment (P < 0.05), while the efficacy of Wenjing decoction was protruded after treatment and significantly higher than the other three groups (P < 0.05). Conclusions: Wenjing decoction has significant efficacy for the RNDs and is worthy of clinical use.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional data comprehensive analysis platform for equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The multi-dimensional data comprehensive analysis platform for cigarette equipment is based on data standards, smart fusion and data governance technology. It uses multi-dimensional analysis, deep mining and other computer technologies to form a highly intelligent business system platform for the operation and maintenance of the entire Tengzhou cigarette factory, management, cost and other fields of information integration, analysis, judgment and forecast.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Optimization Design for New Transmission System of High-Efficiency Shearer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Shearer is one of the core equipment of modern fully mechanized mining equipment, which is an important milestone marking the leap forward of China's mineral resources from labor-intensive to mechanized and intelligent output. At present, the cutting part of most shearers adopts the structural form of multi-stage involute spur gear linkage. The complex and large number of transmission parts have the problems of complex spatial structure and low transmission efficiency in the implementation of long-distance transmission of large torque. This paper puts forward the improved design scheme of “two-stage spur gear - two-stage bevel gear - two-stage planetary gear which greatly reduces the energy loss in the normal working process of the equipment, improves the transmission efficiency, and simplifies the spatial structure. Based on the strength theory, the weight with optimal bearing capacity and minimum volume is determined as the objective optimization function. According to the multi index constrained boundary conditions, the optimal gear train design parameters are obtained by ant colony algorithm, and the design strength meets the use requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Geostress Inversion Method of Computer Big Data Technology in Support Vector Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The in-situ stress field is the basic data for the excavation and support design of deep my roadways. The article uses support vector machine (SVM) theory based on statistical learning theory to establish a calculation model. At the same time, the data of the horizontal maximum ground stress and pore pressure field measured at the well site were used to perform a fitting and the influence of the kernel function in the fitting calculation was compared and analyzed. Based on the principle of support vector machine, the mechanical parameters and initial stress field of the calculation area are inverted. The calculated results are basically consistent with the measured in-situ stress values and meet the accuracy requirements. This shows that the inversion result is consistent with the actual project, and the inversion method used is reasonable.

articleTitle: Security technology of computer information system based on DES data encryption algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Although the traditional firewall technology can encrypt information, its efficiency is low. Therefore, the security technology of computer information system based on DES data encryption algorithm is designed. This technology can search the confidential information in the computer, encrypt the data based on DES data encryption algorithm, and manage the computer information key, so as to realize the confidentiality of computer information. The experimental results show that the designed computer information security technology can still maintain a good security function in the face of a large amount of data information, so it has a certain application value.

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of peak adjustment and low load operation on turbine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to grasp the problems existing when the unit participates in start-stop peak load shaving, depth peak load shaving and low load operation, and to effectively provide technical support for flexible transformation of the unit. Through investigation and investigation, the problems encountered in participating in peak load regulation and low load operation of power plants are understood, as well as the corresponding countermeasures adopted by each power plant. The influence of peak load regulation and low load operation on steam turbine and its auxiliary equipment is summarized.

articleTitle: Computer-aided integrated design technology of electromechanical products based on meta-action decomposition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article focuses on the long-standing quality problems of electromechanical products, such as poor accuracy, short accuracy life, large performance fluctuations, and frequent failures. This article takes electromechanical products as the research object, based on the definition of the meta-action unit system and omni-directional modeling, and the accuracy The predictive control of the four key quality characteristics of, precision life, performance stability and reliability is the core. Based on the actual situation, the main points of the computer-aided integration technology design of mechatronics products are studied, and the development of mechatronics technology is discussed first. Secondly, it analyzes the application of computer-aided technology in mechatronics design. Using large-scale system research methods to systematically study the definition and modeling of meta-action units, the formation mechanism of key quality characteristics, the fusion control mechanism of quality characteristics, and the coupling and decoupling technology of whole machine quality characteristics based on meta-action units, predictive control models and other key sciences For the problem, the numerical control machine tool is used as a typical case for theoretical verification and application, and a set of key quality characteristic analysis and predictive control methods based on meta-action units is proposed for electromechanical products, which provides theoretical and technical support for essentially ensuring the quality of electromechanical products.

articleTitle: Analysis of Online Learning Behavior Based on Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of “Internet + education”, learners use online learning platform to carry out independent learning into the popularization stage, this study constructed online learning behavior analysis model. The clustering algorithm of data mining technology is used to analyze and generate a learning behavior analysis report, which promotes teachers to improve their teaching and implement teaching intervention, and provides suggestions for learners to improve their learning behavior.

articleTitle: Computer Evaluation Model of the Effect of Electro-Acupuncture on Dysfunction Based on Intelligent Detection and Calculation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Cerebral apoplexy, also known as stroke in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), is a common, frequently encountered disease of extremely high incidence rate, disability, mortality, and recurrence rate. The acupuncture therapy in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) has been found having excellent therapeutic effects on stroke. The review summarizes recent clinical studies on treatment of motor dysfunction of limbs in post-stroke patients using various acupuncture therapies such as body acupuncture, electroacupuncture (EA), auricular acupuncture, scalp acupuncture, fire-needle therapy, and meridian acupuncture, as well as combinations of acupuncture separately with rehabilitation and medicine. Moreover, existing problems in the research are also raised.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Simulation and Interactive Experience of Internet Technology in Flipped Classroom Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: High-quality resources and services are an important guarantee for effective flipped classroom practice. For this reason, a system that can meet the needs of resources and services in all aspects of flipped classroom teaching has been designed. The system has the characteristics of serviceability and innovation, personalization and intelligence, reasonable resource classification and open co-construction and sharing, interactivity and immediacy, maintainability and scalability. On the basis of making full use of WinCC visualization and MATLAB’s powerful computing functions, combined with OPC technology, developed a set of virtual process control experimental teaching system that is easy to expand, friendly interface, and open algorithm. On this basis, a process control system flip class is built. Teaching mode. This teaching mode has a significant effect on students’ deepening understanding and mastery of process control system design and improving engineering practice ability.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Advanced Ground Motion Guidance and Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The Advanced Ground Motion Guidance and Control System (A-GMGCS), hereinafter referred to as the Advanced Ground Motion Guidance and Control System (ASMGCS) [1], is A system that provides surveillance, routing, guidance and control support for airport traffic. In this paper, A-GMGCS is investigated and analyzed, including the concept, background and development status of the system, and the main functions proposed by A-GMGCS are demonstrated. A simulation of the A-GMGCS is introduced to demonstrate a basic airport ground motion model. This simulation approach and implementation is presented to express the practical applications of the A-GMGCS.

articleTitle: Computer intelligent prediction method of COVID-19 based on improved SEIR model and machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to predict the COVID-19 outbreak, several epidemiological models are used around the world to predict the number of infections and mortality. An accurate predictive model is essential to take appropriate action. Based on the Wuhan epidemic data, considering that the virus infection rate in the traditional SEIR model cannot be automatically predicted and the infection situation of patients in the incubation period is not considered, this article first improves the SEIR model to increase the number of confirmed admissions, and secondly based on LSTM and The SEIR model predicts confirmed and potential cases of the epidemic. To a certain extent, it can provide a reference for people to predict the development trend of the epidemic under the current prevention and control measures.

articleTitle: Research on the Smart Distribution Network Management System under the Rapid Development of Distributed Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Under the goal of “carbon peak and carbon neutrality”, distributed power generation will develop rapidly, which will have a profound impact on the traditional power grid management system. Through research and analysis, this paper finds that distribution network management will face five important changes, such as a large increase in business volume and changes in the nature of users, which constitute the inducing factors for management changes. At the same time, it also proposes to reshape the power grid management authority and establish an adaptive distributed power generation system. The transaction mechanism and other aspects of the initiative.

articleTitle: Research on the Anti-risk Ability Intelligent Evaluation System of Distributed Data Centers without Human Intervention
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
