abstract: Using the association rules of the basic data of the whole link, the operation history law scenarios and the operation status risk perception methods among the distributed data centers are respectively studied. Modeling methods can be used to summarize the normal operation rules of various systems, and the operation rules can be used to find abnormal operation, and then determine the risk content. Its operation can be divided into different regularity stages to be distinguished, grasp the proportional relationship of each resource load in each stage, and realize the quantification of the regularity as a data index. Perform simulation tests to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Realize the quantification of abnormalities as data indicators, and then realize the conversion to risk judgments.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Big Data and Software Tools in Remote Network Training Course Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The development of information science provides the most advanced methods and approaches for the prosperity of sports, standardizing sports management and strengthening sports training. In response to the current needs of the teaching and promotion of track and field courses, this article designs a track and field course "teaching and training" auxiliary examination system for teachers' professional certification schools. The article first analyzes the requirements of the system in detail from both functional and non-functional aspects. Secondly, according to the design idea of the system, the B/S structure is adopted and the overall design and data table of the system are analyzed and described. Finally, the specific modules of the system are implemented.

Author Keywords: track and field course assistant system

articleTitle: Classification network of Chest X-ray images based on residual network in the context of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As COVID-19 spreads across the globe, more cases are being confirmed around the world, making it imperative that we take a better approach to fighting the outbreak. To stop the spread of the disease and better screen for cases, we need a more sensitive and efficient test that can classify images of lung abnormalities in patients. In this paper, residual network is used to classify the collected chest radiographs. Feature extraction and classification were carried out on the original chest X-ray images, which were divided into the following three categories: normal lung, bacterial pneumonia and virus pneumonia. This can quickly rule out normal and routine infections, screen out large numbers of cases, and reduce the burden on health care workers who need to further examine cases. At the same time, our results are also very good, with an accuracy of 94%, which has practical classification significance.

articleTitle: Design of a simulation system for authenticity reproduction of cultural relics images in digital museums based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The traditional method first converts images of different dimensions, and then introduces the characteristics of the human visual system, but ignores the smoothing of the image, which leads to the unsatisfactory effect of image reproduction. Based on the data mining algorithm, this paper has done a research on the authenticity of the digital museum’s cultural relic image. A method of authenticity reproduction of cultural relics images based on data mining is proposed. In order to realize the authentic reproduction of cultural relics images, this paper designs a digital museum cultural relics image authenticity reproduction simulation system to solve the problems of poor noise suppression, missing holes, poor reproduction quality of cultural relics, and insufficient details in traditional systems. It is necessary to first calculate the optimal neighborhood range of the cultural relic image pixel, and then perform the restrictive smoothing of the image edge to complete the authenticity restoration of the cultural relic image. The hole phenomenon in the process of data mining triangulation is filled in. The spline function least squares method is selected for surface fitting, two-dimensional texture coordinates are established through data mining algorithm mapping, and the image texture is mapped to the surface grid to realize the three-dimensional reconstruction of the cultural relic image.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Open Circuit Fault of Diode Clamped Three-level Inverter Based on GWO-SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that of difficulty in locating open circuit faults of diode-clamped three-level inverters and low fault diagnosis accuracy, this paper proposes an open-circuit fault diagnosis model of diode clamped three-level inverter based on Grey Wolf Optimizer to optimize Support Vector Machine. By studying the law of the output current change of the three-level inverter during normal and open circuit faults, the special diagnosis parameters of the output current are extracted as the characteristic quantities of the model proposed for the inverter open-circuit fault diagnosis research. Experimental verification shows that compared with the traditional SVM model, the diagnostic model proposed in this paper has higher diagnostic accuracy and smaller relative error, and can effectively realize the open-circuit fault diagnosis of the diode-clamped three-level inverter.

articleTitle: Research on the development of computer simulation technology in the context of blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Block chain is, along with the rising popularity of digital encryption currency such as COINS and gradually rise a new decentralized architecture and distributed computing paradigm, decentralization, time-series data, collective maintenance and programmable and safety reliable, has caused the government departments, financial institutions, science and technology enterprises and capital market attaches great importance and wide public concern. As the world accelerates into the “blockchain economic era”, blockchain technology has shown a spurt of growth. As a disruptive underlying technology, it has been continuously applied in various industries and attracted more and more heed from all over the world. Blockchain + simulation industry has also become a new trend in the development of simulation technology. By deconstructing the core elements of blockchain, this paper puts forward the infrastructure model of blockchain system, expounds and analyzes what blockchain is, the blockchain’s development tendency, their relationship between blockchain and virtual simulation, and gives examples for analysis.

articleTitle: A Coding Scheme for Urban Area in Remote Sensing Optical Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Urban area has rich texture and structure information, especially from high-resolution optical images. Reducing the loss of textures and structures caused by image compression is very important for remote sensing applications. In this letter, we proposed a compression scheme for urban area based on its inherent characteristic and applications. The original image is represented by a combined dictionary. The learnt atoms are propitious to texture parts representing, and the atoms generated by Gaussian derivative functions are used to enhance the edges. Sparse coding is carried out by matching pursuit algorithm. Finally, Huffman code is applied for entropy coding. The experiments show that the proposed approach outperforms some well-known schemes in terms of texture distortion and geometric distortion.

articleTitle: Automatic Recognition of Whale and Dolphin Whistles Based on Visual Feature Extraction Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Automatic recognition of marine mammals plays a significant role in the protection of endangered marine species, generally utilizing their vocalizations. In this paper, we propose a novel visual feature extraction approach for whale and dolphin signals incorporating variational mode decomposition (VMD) and Hilbert transform (VMD-HT) to construct the high-resolution time-frequency signatures and using gray level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) to extort image features. Firstly, the objected signals are decomposed by VMD algorithm into multiple intrinsic mode functions (IMFs), which can capture local frequency features precisely. Secondly, the time-frequency signature of the objected signal with high resolution is constructed by linear superposition operation of each IMF time-frequency image depicted through Hilbert transform (HT). Thirdly, the image features are extracted using GLCM. Eventually, support vector machine (SVM) is adopted to validate the classification performance of the proposed method. The experimental results verify that the resolution improvement of time-frequency image attains the correct recognition rate and the proposed method accuracy is higher than the compared method about 11.11%

articleTitle: Identifying influential impulsive controllers in multi-agent systems with digraph topologies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Control and stabilization of large scale networked systems is an interesting problem in science and engineering. In this paper, we consider the impulsive pinning control problem and identify the best impulsive controllers to maximize the convergence rate of multi-agent systems with directed graph topologies. Based on the matrix perturbation theory, we derive formulas in terms of first-order approximation, which indicates that the normalized nonnegative left eigenvector of the Laplacian matrix corresponding to eigenvalue zero measures the importance of node in impulsive pinning control multi-agent systems. Numerical experiments on different networks reveal the effectiveness of theoretical results.

articleTitle: A Management Technology of Electrical User Data Label Based on Artificial Intelligence Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, it has been applied in various businesses of enterprises. State Grid Corporation of China generates massive amounts of electricity user data in its regular business. The processing and application of such data mainly rely on manual extraction, classification, and visual processing. This method has low efficiency, high labor cost, and low accuracy. Therefore, the technology of artificial intelligence recognition technology has become an ideal new alternative. This paper is based on the Globe (Global Vectors for Word Representation, Globe) model to identify and represent electrical customer data and label different types of data, and finally build a new set of electrical user data label management technology. It realizes the efficient storage and management of massive electrical user data.

articleTitle: Research on Query System of Knowledge Service Search Engine Based on Internet Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Providing users with effective personalized knowledge services is one of the development directions of information services in institutions such as libraries. The article constructs a personalized knowledge service system based on ontology by introducing ontology theory. The system uses the ontology to uniformly describe and reconstruct the multi-domain and cross-database document library. On this basis, a user personality characteristic model and a personalized knowledge retrieval model are further proposed, so that the system can realize personalized retrieval on the semantic level among multiple document databases. The system improves the efficiency and quality of knowledge services.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Segmentation Algorithm and Terminal Adaptation Technology of Vertical(Transverse)comic Mobile Phone Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Vertical(Transverse)comic is a kind of comic expression that is flourishing with the rise of the Internet. Although it has not been developed for a long time, it has a rapid momentum, and it has great momentum to replace the traditional comic expression. Intelligent segmentation of mobile phone Vertical(Transverse)comic is one of the basic and key technologies in image processing and computer vision. Among the intelligent segmentation methods of mobile phone Vertical(Transverse)comic, threshold method is one of the common methods. On the basis of basic GA (Genetic Algorithm) research, this paper improves the selection operator, crossover operator and mutation operator of GA to some extent, and combines the improved GA with two-dimensional maximum entropy method and two-dimensional maximum inter-class variance method to propose a mobile phone Vertical(Transverse)comic intelligent segmentation algorithm. Different images are segmented, and the feasibility and segmentation performance of the new method are verified. In addition, the paper also developed the management module of Web page adaptation system, which can manage the configuration of the adaptation system.

articleTitle: A method for automatic segmentation of tactile pavement in outdoor environments
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the complex outdoor situation, the tactile pavement area in the captured images is prone to shadows and noise, which causes inaccurate tactile pavement segmentation. Based on the Y component of the YUV color space representing the luminance information, the shadow regions in the images are extracted and chromaticity correction is performed; a tactile pavement automatic segmentation algorithm in the outdoor environment is proposed by combining the maximum inter-class variance (OTSU) algorithm and the watershed segmentation algorithm. The OTSU algorithm is used to segment the pre-processed image, initially extract the tactile pavement region, combine the distance transform to label the image, and the watershed algorithm then uses the label for tactile pavement segmentation. The experiment proves that the method can avoid the influence of the shadow part in the image on the segmentation algorithm and improve the effectiveness of the segmentation of outdoor tactile pavement.

articleTitle: Application of BIM technology in the reconstruction of switchyard of hydropower station
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The terrain of Xin’anjiang switchyard is complex and the site is very small, which makes the reconstruction of switchyard is very difficult. In the process of switchyard reconstruction of Xin’anjiang hydropower station, the BIM model before the reconstruction of switchyard is established by using laser scanning technology and BIM technology. BIM-4D virtual construction is carried out for the reconstruction of switchyard based on fuzor software platform, optimizing 4 unreasonable construction arrangements while saving 15 days of the construction time and creating economic benefits of RMB 13.099 million..

articleTitle: Vision-based Method of Detecting Geometric Parameters of Railway Catenary
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the need for dynamic and high-precision detection of railway catenary geometric parameters, a method of detecting geometrical parameters of catenary based on the principle of structured light vision is proposed in this paper. The structured light vision measurement system is adopted to obtain the geometric feature images of catenary, and the template matching method is used to obtain the detection points in the image, and then get the geometric parameters of the catenary. Line tests have been conducted on Xi’an Metro Line 1 and the Daxi High-speed Railway (Xi’an North Section) line extension. The results show that the vision-based detection method for geometric parameters of the catenary has high accuracy and stability, and has broad application prospects.

Author Keywords: Detection of geometric parameter of catenary

articleTitle: An Efficient MAC Protocol for PLC Based on STA Slots
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Nowadays PLC are existence measured as a substitute for high hustle data infrastructures and internet interaction. Presently BPLC is a part for AMI and HAN with several channels in nearly each rooms, PL’S are now the most collective network in the ordinary or small office. This works presents a new media access control MAC protocol for access PLC networks. The beacon time slot allocates all access points to their own site time slots. It is not necessary to send each STA's beacon slot in a beacon period, reducing the time for sending data messages. In the process of multi-site access to the network, some STAs still broadcast and send discovery beacons when no new nodes are connected to the network, which will cause the broadcast of the discovery beacon to be worthless and waste broadcast frames and discovery beacon slots. In order to send as many data frames as possible in a beacon period. Outcomes of OPNET 14.5 simulation illustration that compared with the system of literature [12] protocol and IEEE 1901.1 protocol. Proposed new EMA-PLCS protocol has enhanced Success rate, Average ETE delay of network, Network throughput, and number of STA slots.

articleTitle: A Multi-period Coordinated Balancing Mechanism Considering Medium- and Long-term Electricity Transactions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of existing medium-and long-term electricity transactions in China, a coordinated balancing mechanism is proposed. Under the designed balancing mechanism and considering the forecast error characteristics of renewable energy, a multi-time scale rolling dispatch model is established. It focuses on the trading products and balance strategies under various time scales in different markets, clarifies the connection between timescales. The proposed balancing mechanism can effectively promote the integration of renewable energy, reduce the overall operation cost of the system. Finally, the balancing mechanism of the method and the model is verified through the PJM 5-bus system simulation.

articleTitle: Theoretical Framework & Engineering Methodology of Cloud-Based Open Cyber Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To facilitate efforts to transform the domain-specific business vendor to be customer-centered, results-oriented, and market-based cyber-organization or e-organization, with the advances of Advanced Computing Technologies (ACT). In this paper we propose an engineering methodology and theoretical framework of constructing of an open, shared, collaborative multiple-tenant, multiple-organization domain-specific (SMEs enterprise, education, healthcare & wellness, farming etc.) digital service ecosystem. The theoretical description of Cloud-based Open Cyber Infrastructure (COCI) model, as well as the software infrastructure for such a model, are developed to implement the knowledge-intensive cyber-service environment for the domain-specific business vendors. Our approach provides an ACT solution to transform the physical-vendors into cyber-vendors or e-vendors with the low-cost, high-availability, economical. At the same time, we put the forward the concept of Knowledge-intensive Model as a Service (KMaaS) to meet the need of enhance the productivity and service pattern reshaping

articleTitle: International Development Trend Analysis of Unmanned Surface Vehicle Based on Bibliometrics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Unmanned Surface Vehicle is a new type of intelligent maritime unmanned equipment, which has been widely used in ecological environment monitoring, maritime search and rescue, hydrological survey, offshore patrol, long-range reconnaissance and other fields. Based on the databases of CNKI and SCI-Expanded (SCIE), this paper searched the literature on Unmanned Surface Vehicle and analyzed the trend of publication of Unmanned Surface Vehicle at home and abroad, cooperative relations between countries and institutions, and research hotspots of unmanned ships by means of bibliometrics and text mining, so as to reveal the international development trend of Unmanned Surface Vehicle research. It provides valuable reference for our Unmanned Surface Vehicle research.

articleTitle: Research on the evolution trend of grid load characteristics in high proportion renewable energy access scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The access of high proportion of renewable energy will have a great impact on the load characteristics of power grid. The resulting lack of power grid flexibility and climbing ability will also seriously affect the reliability of power system operation. Based on this, it becomes increasingly important to study the evolution trend of grid load characteristics in the scenario of high proportion of renewable energy access. Firstly, the classification of power load is analyzed. Then the power system load characteristic analysis index system is constructed and the influencing factors of load characteristic are studied. Then the load characteristic prediction model is constructed and the load characteristic prediction is carried out considering the influence of long-term economy and electricity structure change. Finally, based on the prediction results of load characteristics, the evolution trend of future load characteristics is analyzed from two scenarios considering the impact of industrial structure development and energy technology change.

articleTitle: Power grid data intelligent management and application under the background of big data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the popularization of new technologies such as big data, cloud computing and the Internet of things in the construction of smart grid, power data is showing explosive growth. Traditional power enterprises rely on manpower to collect data and recover arrears. During the period of COVID-19, the closed management of government departments, the arrears of electricity customers and no power outages made the recovery work more difficult. In this paper, through the mining and analysis of customers’ historical payment data, historical electricity and other data, using the deep learning algorithm in the field of artificial intelligence, this paper constructs a mathematical model and formulates the prevention and control strategy of electricity charge recovery risk of business travel alienation. The application results show that the new strategy can effectively reduce the amount of customer arrears and comprehensively improve the lean, digital and intelligent management level of power supply enterprises.

articleTitle: Damaged Insulator Detection Based on Matching Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Traditional transmission line inspection of the power system is mostly manual inspection, but with the emergence of higher voltage, higher power, longer distance transmission lines, and more complicated geographical environment which the line through, the application of helicopters or UAVs to complete the circuit inspection task has become the need of the development of the times. We use a neural network to process the images collected by the equipment and mark the transformers, circuit breakers, knife switches, transformers, power cables, insulators and other parts in the images. However, due to the unobvious rules of demaged parts, the hard-to-achieve manual labeling task, the lack of a large number of damaged parts of the image data, it is difficult to train an effective neural network for the screening of damaged parts. Moreover, gradients may disappear in high-level networks because of the scene is complexity and the components to be detected are likely to be occluded. In this paper, we use the idea of small sample learning matching network and match the semantic information of the image with the double attention model to propose a detection scheme that takes the detection of damaged insulators as an example.

articleTitle: Research on Mathematical Model of Relationship between Big Data Analysis Capability and Supply Chain Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous emergence of a series of emerging technologies on the Internet, technologies such as big data and artificial intelligence have had a greater impact on supply chain management. Among them, one of the important capabilities that supply chain companies should possess is the ability to analyze big data, which has a particularly significant impact on supply chain performance management. In enterprises of different sizes, how big data analysis capabilities play a role, what impact it has on supply chain performance, and how important its importance are are all questions worth exploring. Based on the theory of dynamic capabilities, this paper introduces supply chain strategy as an intermediate mechanism between big data capability analysis and supply chain performance, and studies the relationship between the three. Quantify sample data on the basis of questionnaire surveys and use SPSS analysis software to use hierarchical regression analysis on sample data to study the impact of big data analysis capabilities on supply chain performance. The results show that: 1. Big data analysis based on artificial intelligence has a positive and direct effect on supply chain performance. 2. Big data analysis ability not only has a direct positive effect on supply chain performance, but also has an indirect effect on supply chain performance through supply chain strategy.

articleTitle: Homogeneous Charge Compression Ignition (HCCI) Engine Control Strategies and Fuel-air Mixture Preparation Research
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of transportation in 21st century, the increasing demands of conventional fuels trigger off serious issues like climate change, health problem and fuel shortage, etc. To reduce the reliance on crude oils, the automobile industry has begun doing research for alternative engines and make some progress recently. This paper starts from concise backgrounds of fossil fuels and brief working principle of HCCI and summarize their strengths and weaknesses compared to conventional engines like less NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> but narrow load range. Besides, it also explains two approaches for homogeneous preparation, improvement of homogeneity and delay of auto-ignition, and finally mentions the future potential and research direction of HCCI.

articleTitle: A Study of an All-in-One Machine for Braille Learning and Testing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Braille assisted learning equipment that is now accessible lacks the ability to measure learning results, is less effective for users, and is more expensive and less portable, making it less widely available. This paper proposes an all-in-one machine for Braille learning and testing to address these concerns. The all-in-one machine features two testing modes for testing learning outcomes, which can significantly improve learning efficiency; the mechanical structure is designed and 3D printed to meet the challenges of high cost and portability, which can improve portability while lowering costs. Furthermore, it is equipped with a remote-control APP, which allows teachers or administrators to control multiple devices and receive feedback on how to use the device, as well as count the user’s learning time and test accuracy rate, to better control the user’s learning situation. This all-in-one machine for Braille learning and testing with remote control fills a gap in the field of Braille learning and testing devices, increasing user’s learning efficiency and the popularity of Braille learning aids.

articleTitle: High-Speed Speculative Decimal Adder Based on Majority Logic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Due to the demand of high accuracy computation in commercial computing, financial analysis, and other applications, there is a rising demand for high-performance decimal arithmetic. The current decimal adder based on the characteristics of majority logic (ML) is designed by ripple-carry decimal adder (RCDA) with the slower speed. A high-speed speculative decimal adder based on ML is proposed in this paper. The proposed adders are based on an improved design of the binary parallel-prefix network. Compared with the best existing designs, the proposed 64-digit decimal adder achieve over 66% less delay, and has a 39.4% improvement of area-delay product.

articleTitle: Discussion on a Method of Designing Intelligent Disinfection Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A robot system which can control area disinfection autonomously was developed in this research. The open source robot operating system (ROS) is used to realize the internal control and coordination of the robot and the open source Gmapping algorithm is used to build the map. After voice awakening, the image recognition and sensor data can be used to disinfect the lamp in a specific area according to the command through disinfection reagent or ultraviolet disinfection. When in the crowd, according to the portrait information returned by the camera, the voice prompt whether to wear a mask is realized by using the training of deep learning related algorithm. According to the received odometer data and depth sensor data, the coordinate system transformation of the robot is maintained to realize the disinfection task of the specified area.

articleTitle: Optimized Energy Saving Strategy for LoRa Protocol
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As the mainstream technology of the future low-power wide area network, LoRa network has been widely studied. Although LoRaWAN uses physical layer technology to provide low power consumption, the energy consumption of battery-based network endpoints still faces significant challenges. The energy saving problem of network terminal nodes has always been one of the most important issues in the research of LoRa networks. In this paper, the DTOP (Dynamic Turning Off the Ping time-slots) mechanism that LoRa terminals dynamically shut down redundant ping timeslots is proposed. This mechanism can achieve low power consumption by turning off LoRa terminal unnecessary receive window in LoRa Class B mode. Test results and theoretical analysis show that the energy saved by the algorithm is positively related to the number of closed ping timeslots. Test results show that 80mJ of energy can be saved within 30 minutes’ test.

articleTitle: Logistics regression model and its application research in computer intelligent assessment system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises small in scale, weak anti-risk ability, short life cycle, and poor information transparency characteristics caused by small and medium-sized enterprise financing difficult problem, this article from the perspective of optimizing macroscopic evaluation index to enhance the validity of the credit risk assessment model, both the operability of the model, simplicity, extracted the 5 mses relevant financial data,By constructing the logistics regression model, the quick ratio as the core and the flow ratio as the auxiliary are compared with the market average quick ratio, so as to measure the credit risk degree of China’s small and medium-sized enterprises and point out that the logistics regression method is more suitable to measure the credit risk degree of China’s small and medium-sized enterprises.It can provide ideas for commercial banks to establish a reasonable and effective sme credit risk assessment system, so as to achieve a win-win situation between commercial banks and smes.

articleTitle: Analysis of Trellis Code Modulation Technology in Satellite High Speed Data Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Satellite remote sensing systems are now widely used in military and civilian fields, and are developing rapidly. However, because the remote sensing receiver of the ground satellite often requires a lot of time and energy to debug the satellite in orbit during the development process, it is also very important to study the satellite image transmission system composed of the ground receiver and the supporting simulator. In this paper, the grid code modulation technology in the satellite high-speed data transmission system is researched. Based on the literature, the satellite high-speed data transmission system and the related theory of the grid code modulation technology are understood, and then the satellite high-speed data transmission system is designed. Finally, the trellis coding modulation technology in the system is tested. The test results show that when the bit error rate is 0.3, the new concatenated code in this paper has a coding gain of 2dB than the ordinary convolutional code, and the NASA proposed NASA Compared with the code, there is also a coding gain of 1dB.

articleTitle: Intelligent control system and pests mathematical prediction model based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, based on the formation conditions of climate and topography, the disease of apple is analyzed and predicted by using machine learning method. The prediction results are combined with the intelligent control of mobile ceiling to realize the discrimination and control of apple growth environment and reduce the impact of environmental factors on apple diseases and pests. The system can reduce the inaccuracy of artificial prediction, improve the accuracy of disease prediction, reduce the environmental pollution caused by pesticide abuse, Then improve the quality and yield of apple.

articleTitle: Research on Social Media Feature Learning Algorithm Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of social media nowadays, a large amount of information, especially text-based information, is widely spread in social media, which exposes the defects of the original text mining technology. For a large amount of text data, a deep neural network can reduce the dimensionality of a large number of text features, and increase the speed without compromising its accuracy. Based on this, this paper proposes a text feature extraction algorithm based on deep neural network, the main purpose is to improve the efficiency of current text mining, so as to improve the efficiency of modern social media use.

articleTitle: Intelligent friction testing for lubricating properties of ionic liquids under an external electric field
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The lubrication performance of ionic liquids under the action of an applied electric field was investigated using a reciprocating sliding friction and wear tester. The friction and wear properties of imidazole ionic liquids with different cations under different electric field, electric field strength, frequency, and load conditions were studied using the control variable method. In addition, the wear scar morphology of the steel balls after the friction test was observed using SEM. An X- ray electron spectrometer was used to characterize the distribution of the main elements on the wear scar surface of the sample, and analyze the wear mechanism. The experimental results show that both the applied electric field and the length of the alkyl chain have a significant effect on the lubricating properties of the ionic liquid.

articleTitle: Research of Drilling Simulation System Based on Unity 3D
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Taking the oil drilling well site as the model, analyze the drilling movement process, and realize the dynamic simulation of the oil drilling process. We establish the 3D model of the oil derrick and import it into Unity 3D software. With the help of the animation system and physics engine of the software, carry out the dynamic simulation and interaction design of the oil well site equipment movement and realize the movement control of the equipment model in the virtual scene such as ascending, descending and rotating motion. The drilling string lifting experiment results show that the designed drilling engineering simulation system has great three-dimensional, interactive and realistic characteristics, which lays a foundation for the establishment of the virtual drilling simulation training system platform.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Course Management System Based on Information Digitization and Database
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This system uses software engineering ideas as a whole, uses My Eclipse as a development environment, Java EE as a development standard, integrates Struts, Hibernate, and MVC to design the architecture and various modules, and uses MySQL database as the basis for the system modules Management of various types of data. This technology not only guarantees the performance of the system, but also covers the scope of general teaching management work. By dividing user roles and realizing hierarchical management, the work of teaching administrators at all levels is fast, convenient, accurate, and safe, and it also provides a good Resource sharing platform.

articleTitle: A Multilevel Graph Convolution Neural Network Model for Rumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Rumor detection is a challenging task on social medias. When a post is propagated on social media, it usually contains four types of information: 1) content; 2) time of publishing; 3) structure of propagation; 4) social interaction. In most previous studies, the information has not been effectively combined to detect rumors. A multilevel graph convolution model including post level and event level is proposed to detect rumors in this paper. For post level graph convolution network based on propagation relationship, it uses a graph convolution network with rumor propagation graph to learn post level features. For event level graph convolution based on event interaction relationship, a graph convolution network with event relationship graph is applied to bridge post level features and event interaction information to obtain the feature representation of events. The experiment results shows that rumor detection accuracy of our model is 94.3%, which is superior to other newly models.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Recognition System of Abnormal Behavior of Big Data Technology Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: At present, the identification of abnormal power consumption behaviors in low- and medium-sized distribution networks has problems such as low efficiency and low accuracy. For this reason, we need to apply big data mining technology to a large amount of electricity consumption data to realize the location of abnormal behavior. Based on this research background, the article proposes an abnormal power consumption recognition model based on the improved K-means algorithm. The model classifies user load curves, extracts characteristic curves and analyzes typical characteristics of their electricity consumption behavior. In this way, the abnormal behavior of electricity consumption in the distribution network is identified. Through experimental analysis, it is found that the optimized K-means clustering algorithm can accurately realize the classification and recognition function of different user types. At the same time, the algorithm can more accurately and effectively analyze the abnormal behavior of users’ electricity consumption.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Field Tests in the Anechoic Chamber Based on the Shared Tower Scale Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to test the effectiveness of the shared tower scale model, the shared tower scale model has been built in the anechoic chamber, and the electromagnetic scattering field test of a single base station antenna and three base station antennas has been carried out. The electric field strength test value and theoretical calculated value at different distances under three frequencies have been compared. The results indicate that the change trend of the measured value and the theoretical calculation value is roughly the same, and the global maximum relative deviation is 8.89%. Combined with error analysis, the accuracy of the shared tower reduction model is basically verified.

articleTitle: Assembly Reliability and Failure Mechanism Analysis of CCGA Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Assembly reliability of ceramic column grid array (CCGA) devices complex in package has relatively great influence on their application. This paper examines the failure mechanisms of board-level surface mount solder joints of CCGA devices in mechanical test and temperature cycle stress. The result shows that the assembly reliability of CCGA devices is affected by the degree of the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) match between solder columns and printed circuit boards (PCB), as well as the coplanarity, uniformity and inner voids of solder columns.

articleTitle: Research on nameplate image recognition algorithm based on R-CNN and SSD deep learning detection methods
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to prevent sudden equipment failures and accidents, it is necessary to conduct regular and irregular regular inspections on important substations and lines. Nameplate is an important power facility, which is usually installed in a prominent position of tower. Due to its long-term exposure to wind and rain, it is prone to damage, scratches and other defects. In this paper, Faster-RCNN based on region suggestion is adopted as the detection algorithm, and the nameplate in the image is identified and located by this algorithm. By selecting the improved LeNet-5 proposed in this paper, the classical Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and ResNetl01 as the basis to extract the network, and comparing the models, the detection results under different framework models are discussed. optimize SSD algorithm to improve the speed and accuracy of image recognition, deeply study the parameter adjustment strategy of deep learning (DL), and build a rich nameplate database for training. The experimental results show that the improved fast SSD algorithm has better performance.

articleTitle: Research on Innovative Design of Batik Vector Pattern Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The vectorization technology of batik pattern is applied to the conceptual design of batik pattern by means of computer-aided design.Through the analysis and research of Guizhou batik patterns, the genetic algorithm is used to reconstruct and innovate the batik patterns.The genetic algorithm of tree structure is applied to the pattern feature tree to realize the cross transformation and recombination among the patterns, and various batik vector graphics with different styles are generated, so as to generate novel batik patterns that meet the designer’s requirements.

articleTitle: Image processing technology based on computer vision algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of intelligent interactive 3D display image distortion, this paper designs a display computer vision system based on ARM processor. The paper realizes the 3D dimensional reconstruction by means of high-speed projector to high-speed projection of transmissive directional scattering screen. Then this paper establishes a mathemational model for distorted images and proposes a deep learning method based on CNN model to correct the distorted images in real time during projection. The experiment shows that the effect of correction is obvious. The system has the advantages of small size, low cost, wide viewing angle, high resolution and strong human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Implementation of dynamic reactive power coordination control strategy based on AVC-SCADA system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Considering the defect of fixed on-off reactor group compensation in AVC system, this paper proposes a coordinated control strategy between virtual air-gap magnetized reactor (MCR SVC reactive power compensator) and AVC system of urban regional power grid. Combined with voltage and reactive power control strategy, a reactive power optimization model with minimum active network loss as objective function is established. It gives full play to the advantages of MCR type SVC reactive power compensator in continuous smooth adjustment of reactive power, and takes IEEE-14 example to carry out co-simulation analysis with PSCAD and MATLAB platform. The results show that dynamic adjustment can effectively reduce the active power loss of the system

articleTitle: A Power Market Transaction Management System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous development and improvement of smart grid systems, related services such as the power market transaction management system power system will also increase in the future, resulting in a large amount of data analysis, processing, and management, and high storage costs. Database solutions, the decentralization and transparency of blockchain technology, and the concept of the energy Internet express their demands. This paper proposes a new blockchain-based power transaction storage system to improve service capabilities in a large-scale system.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Big Data Deep Learning Technology in Mechanical Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that traditional manufacturing and processing equipment is not closely related to data and information in the production and processing process, and the use and maintenance of equipment relies on manual experience, a new method of equipment intelligence is proposed. There are faults in motor manufacturing during machining. Based on the non-stationary and non-linear nature of the motor signal itself, combined with the characteristics of large amount of motor monitoring data and the advantages of deep learning methods in target recognition, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for motor machining based on deep learning.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Grid Based Auxiliary Decision System for Distribution Network Planning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Urban distribution network planning is a complex system engineering, which has the characteristics of large scale, many uncertain and imprecise factors and wide fields. Urban power grid planning is composed of spatial power load forecasting, substation optimization planning and distribution network planning, which is highly complex. At present, distribution network planning is mostly based on manual methods, and hierarchical analysis is usually used to analyze the current situation of equipment load rate, reliability, transfer rate and voltage qualification rate of distribution network. Urban distribution system planning has the characteristics of large amount of data, many uncertain factors, wide fields involved and rapid renewal and change. The complexity of planning makes it impossible for planners to plan only by relying on their previous work experience. Through the research on the auxiliary decision-making of distribution network planning, this paper optimizes and sorts the distribution network planning projects according to the distribution network basic operation information and distribution network operation evaluation results of the planning big data center, so as to improve the pertinence and effectiveness of distribution network planning.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent information management systems and its promotion mechanism using big data technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of information society, big data has led the change of society. As the core part of government performance management, government performance evaluation is an important “booster” to improve government administrative efficiency and promote the transformation of government functions. The government’s responsibility is to undertake the obligation to serve the society and protect the fundamental rights and interests of the people. Government performance evaluation is a professional and specific procedure that combines quantitative and qualitative measurements to accurately evaluate the final performance results of government departments in the management process, so as to test and assess whether or to what extent the government has fulfilled its responsibilities. Government performance evaluation not only realizes the core values and public accountability goals of the government, but also is an effective mechanism for implementing government accountability. However, in reality, there are still many problems in China’s government in fulfilling its responsibilities and running performance evaluation mechanisms. This paper analyzes the current dilemmas and problems in local government performance evaluation based on government responsibility, and then proposes countermeasures to improve the government performance evaluation mechanism under the perspective of government responsibility, thus providing a theoretical basis for the implementation of the correct concept of performance.

articleTitle: A Software for Rapid Annotation of Scene Objects Based on Saliency Object Ranking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence (AI), a mainstream research line in building a non-invasive intelligent system for assisting people with visual disabilities is to capture images with a camera, and then using AI to identify the content of images and convert visual information into auditory information. The key point is to establish high-quality personalized datasets based on real open scenes for AI model training. However, most of existing annotation software is designed for face recognition, automatic driving and other tasks, whose annotation information type is monotonous. Also, when converting an image with multiple objects into audio information, the order of objects needs to be determined. Few studies have focused on this issue currently. Therefore, we develop an image annotation software for rapid construction of small sample databases of AI models that can be used in intelligent blindness assistance systems. The software can additionally mark information such as size and affiliation. Moreover, it has a database module to facilitate the management of multiple annotation tasks. Then, a saliency object ranking network based on multi-task cascade is designed. The object ranking results can provide a reference for the sequence of audio information. The Hit Rate, Relative Ranking accuracy and Saliency Object Ranking score of the ranking network are better than that existing saliency object network on the validation set. Finally, the network is deployed into the software to realize the AI-assisted annotation, and to quickly establish the personalized dataset.

articleTitle: A pseudo three-dimensional sub-satellite point rendering method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The traditional sub-satellite point rendering uses a world plane map based on Mercator projection. This method is simple and efficient, but the deformation is very significant in the area far from the equator, and it increases with the increase of latitude. This paper constructs a pseudo-three-dimensional sub-satellite point rendering method based on orthogonal projection, which does not require the support of a specific hardware environment and rendering engine. Specifically, this method first obtains a series of two-dimensional images by orthogonally projecting the three-dimensional earth model from different viewpoints, and then calculates the two-dimensional image coordinates of the aircraft in the corresponding viewing angle according to the given orthogonal projection of the two-dimensional image and performs the sub-satellite Point rendering, switching the orthogonal projection images under different viewing angles can get a pseudo-three-dimensional sub-satellite point rendering effect. The two aircraft trajectories are drawn based on the Mercator projection image and our algorithm in this paper. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the algorithm in this paper. This algorithm provides a feasible strategy for real-time rendering of 3D sub-satellite points on low-performance equipment.

articleTitle: Anonymous Authentication and Application Stealth Scheme for Mobile Network Based on SPA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: According to the idea of zero trust, this paper proposed an anonymous identity authentication scheme based on hash functions and pseudo-random number generators, which effectively increased the anonymity and confidentiality when users use the mobile networks, and ensure the security of the server. This scheme first used single-packet authentication technology to realize the application stealth. Secondly, hash functions and pseudo-random number generators were used to replace public key cryptosystems and time synchronization systems, which improved system performance. Thirdly, different methods were set to save encrypted information on the user's mobile device and the server, which realized different forms of anonymous authentication and negotiates a secure session key. Through security analysis, function and performance comparison, the results showed that the scheme had better security, flexibility and practicality, while maintained good communication efficiency.

articleTitle: User interest representation intelligent session recommendation model based on multi-attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To solve the problem that it is difficult to take account of user behavior diversity and item features inherent in a limited sequence of user conversation behavior, and a single model cannot make full use of favorable feature information for recommendation matching, In this paper, we propose a User Interest Representation (UIR) session recommendation model (SR-UIAM) integrating Attention Mechanism (AM). Using project information, studies project representation from a multi-dimensional and fine-grained perspective and excavates deeper relationships between users and projects. Finally, some experiments are carried out on two real open benchmark data sets, and the experimental results show that the proposed method can improve the expressiveness of the model and improve the recommendation performance to some extent.

articleTitle: Design of library purchasing decision system under the trend of paper synchronization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to improve the purchasing decision-making ability of library under the trend of paper-electricity synchronization, this paper proposes a design method of library purchasing decision-making system under the trend of paper-electricity synchronization based on embedded collaborative control. The system user interactive operation module of the library procurement decision-making system under the trend of paper-electricity synchronization is constructed. In the distribution domain of library procurement decision-making under the trend of intelligent paper-electricity synchronization, the standardized IEC 61850 standard control protocol is adopted to realize the library procurement decision-making control and serial data processing under the trend of paper-electricity synchronization, and the underlying network communication protocol is adopted to realize the fingerprint parameter analysis of intelligent library electronic reading and the construction of network model base. The feature extraction of library procurement parameters under the trend of paper-electricity synchronization is realized, the information processing model of library procurement decision under the trend of paper-electricity synchronization is constructed, the data information collection of library procurement decision system under the trend of paper-electricity synchronization is realized by using RFID tag identification technology, and the library procurement decision and system hardware design under the trend of paper-electricity synchronization are realized by using embedded ARM and single chip microcomputer technology according to the collaborative visual parameter analysis of relevant data of library procurement decision under the trend of paper-electricity synchronization. The test results show that the accuracy of library purchasing decision-making under the trend of paper-electricity synchronization is high, and the human-computer interaction ability of library purchasing decision-making is strong.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Capacity Configuration of PV Plant Considering Economic Cost
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Introduction of photovoltaic energy storage technologies gives the possibility to stabilize the photovoltaic (PV) output fluctuation; a reasonable choice of storage capacity must take into account the fluctuation requirements of PV output and operation economy of PV plant with energy storage. Therefore, under the condition of scheduling, this paper proposes a cost economy function. The objective function can guarantee the economy of PV plant, and satisfy the fluctuation demand of scheduling center as much as possible, making PV output smoother and more stable. By optimizing the objective function, this paper determines the optimal storage capacity. Calculating and comparing the optimal storage capacity using examples system in different fluctuation demands.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Evaluation Model and Big Data Analysis of Green Reconstruction in the Index System of Intelligent Building
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The article “Urban Renewal” with the transformation of old communities as an important content will become the main development path to improve the quality of the city and meet the needs of residents in the future. Starting from the five dimensions of cost, economic benefit, technical benefit, ecological benefit and social benefit, the article establishes and perfects the comprehensive benefit evaluation index system for the green renovation of old communities. At the same time, we combine big data with police work and social governance work. Taking the construction of smart communities in old communities as an example, analyse its measures and experience in mining and integrating public security governance resources, providing data support for public security governance, and improving the level of public security prevention in old communities. The evaluation results show that the green renovation of the old community has better comprehensive benefits than the traditional renovation.

articleTitle: Research on power equipment diagnosis based on big data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The continuous development of power system is an important guarantee for the rapid development of economy and science and technology in China. The emergence of smart grid has accelerated the development of power big data and artificial intelligence in power field. In smart grid, the state of power equipment determines the state of power system and is the decisive factor for the stable operation of power grid. spark distributed parallel processing system can meet the storage and calculation of big data, and provides a new research idea for realizing fault classification and diagnosis of power equipment under big data. The concept of deep learning provides a platform for the analysis and prediction of power equipment status under big data. This paper introduces the basic contents of power equipment handover test, analyzes the common fault types of power equipment in handover test, introduces the existing fault diagnosis methods, puts forward the scheme of power equipment state diagnosis-based on spark platform, and classifies the faults of power equipment by using the naive Bayesian network in spark, Taking the test data as sample input, the fault diagnosis of power equipment can be carried out. On this basis, through the research of deep learning network, the feasibility of power equipment fault diagnosis is analyzed. The test shows that the method used in this paper can diagnose and predict the state of power equipment effectively.

articleTitle: Computer Internet Technology and Intelligent Quality Control System Applied in Greenhouses Fruits
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The new fruit-type super-sweet fresh corn variety Xuetian 7401 is both cooked and raw. It is known as a treasure of fresh corn and has a broad prospect for promotion. Based on the idea of “Internet +”, the article uses modern information technologies such as intelligent big data management and expert intelligent decision-making to create an integrated fruit and corn greenhouse production and marketing service platform that effectively supervises and provides scientific guidance for the production and marketing of fruit and corn. The platform includes three subsystems: information acquisition system, expert system, and supervision and service application system. The platform can help regulatory agencies effectively supervise the production of fruit corn in greenhouses in real time, use expert decision-making to give producers scientific guidance, provide consumers with information on all aspects of the product, achieve quality traceability and direct online consumption, and complete fruit corn Actively supervise and guide each link of greenhouse production and sales. Finally, build a data centre based on cloud platform technology to build a complete safety production and marketing service and supervision platform for fruit and corn.

articleTitle: Research on hotel energy intelligent monitoring system and service improvement based on data mining and cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Many modern hotels have multiple functions such as accommodation, catering, entertainment, conferences, exhibitions, etc., and consume a lot of energy. At present, most of the predictions of building energy consumption are predictions of building cooling and heating loads and lighting energy consumption. The consideration is lack of building cooling (heating) area ratios, building cooling (heating) methods, meteorological parameters, and personnel activity patterns for large public buildings. By analyzing the data mining status of hotel energy consumption, sorting out concepts and technical support conditions, etc., the article has established a more comprehensive energy monitoring, forecasting, and evaluation system, which has enriched the research scope of the current hotel energy management research system, and has a strong Theoretical significance.

articleTitle: Design of TT&C data Exchanging Ground System Based on Restrictive Publish/Subscribe Pattern
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Focus on enhancing the TT&C data exchange rate and flexibility, this paper put forward a kind of TT&C data exchanging ground system based on restrictive publish/subscribe pattern. System architecture was designed, the core data exchange software was discussed, the data subscribe mechanism and data matching filter mechanism were also studied.

articleTitle: Multi-head Fusion Attention Mechanism based on Strip Pooling for Road Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Recent research shows that strip pooling can effectively improve the performance of the model. In this paper, we use efficientnet as the backbone network in the structure of UNet to perform strip pooling of feature maps of different scales, and use the multi-head attention mechanism to fuse the obtained features by strip pooling, thus improving the model’s ability to detect remotely sensed roads. Strip pooling can capture the remote dependency of the context and improve the detection ability of slender objects. The multi-head attention mechanism can use the correlation between features of different scales to enhance the expression of their respective features. We apply the proposed model to remote sensing data sets, which can significantly improve the IoU score and the accuracy of pixel classification of the UNet baseline model.

articleTitle: A bilevel optimization approach for estimating annealing parameters in image restoration problem
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the variational models of image restoration, the selection of reasonable regularization parameter is very important. The simulated annealing algorithm improves the computational efficiency by setting monotonically increasing the parameters, but the determination of annealing parameters is based on prior knowledge. In this paper, the optimal annealing parameters estimation model that utilize bilevel optimization approach and different variance image is proposed. And the effective adaptive updating algorithm based on back-propagation algorithm is also proposed. The numerical simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can not only adaptively learn a set of annealing parameters from the data, but also be suitable for the multi-noise variance image restoration problem. Moreover, the annealing parameters with the monotone increasing trend in the experimental results, which verifies the prior conditions of the simulated annealing algorithm.

articleTitle: MDBST: Multi-Different-Branch Siamese Network for Object Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the field of machine vision, object tracking tasks have always been a hot issue for many researchers. In recent years, many excellent trackers based on deep learning have achieved very advanced performance in object tracking tasks. However, many trackers use a single-branch feature extraction network to design trackers. Researchers are constantly increasing the depth of the feature extraction network while ignoring the width of the network. If the depth of the network is too deep, the size of the output feature map will be too small, which will affect the tracking results. Therefore, in order to balance the depth and feature extraction ability of the feature extraction network, this paper proposes a multi-different-branch feature extraction network. We design a feature extraction module and add the residual module at the same time, design two different branches to perform feature extraction in parallel, and concatenate the feature maps output by the two branches. Effectively extract all aspects of feature information of the object, and improve the accuracy and robustness of target tracking. We embed the feature extraction network into siamese network and conduct extensive experiments on the OTB2015 and VOT2016 benchmark datasets. The results show that our MDBST tracker has achieved excellent results.
